cues.type: foley + atmos + production dialogue (decorum at the bar)
cues.timing: Pilot SC05-SC08, about 180-660 s (3:00-11:00); 'Have we met before?' at the top of SC05, about 180 s; first verdict in SC06, about 330-480 s; SC08 window from about 585 s; picture-led
cues.description: We hear the game on the counter, and nothing scores it (A08: no jukebox, no bar music). VENUS: “Have we met before?” opens it over the near-empty room. VENUS: “How about I get this first round. Two Naked and Famous.” Two glasses land together. A straw laid flat in a wet ring makes a soft, tacky tick, a straw drawn back out makes a dry slide, and a glass is set down for every drink, so each lost straw has its own sound. SC06: VENUS: “A true martyr on a Thursday night, alone in an empty bar. Who slayed you, my friend?” JEAN: “She left. Packed while I was at work. I never once raised my voice.” Her glass goes down, then the wall straw slides dryly out, then JEAN: “That's a no?” VENUS: “That's a drink.” SC07: the chimney straw is pushed into the soft candle wax with a faint drag. SC08, through the window: nothing is heard from inside, only the street side, a far car and wind at the door frame. The laughs are seen, not heard, and the cuts land on them. The coupe rocking on the base straw is silent too. Inside at last call the room comes back. The glasses are cleared. JEAN's phone photo is taken with no shutter sound (A10). The chimney comes out of the wax with a tiny soft release and ticks once against the tin in her jacket pocket. The room is carried by a drinks-fridge compressor and a glass washer, and any background voices are unintelligible walla. Dialogue is recorded clean on set. Cut on the laughs (tone: genuine).
cues.licensing_or_consent_requirement: Source: foley recorded for this production, and production dialogue recorded on set with the Venus, Jean and Bartender actors, whose written consent for the pilot scope is required. Walla is recorded with consented background performers and kept unintelligible. 'Naked and Famous' is a spoken cocktail name; the producer's check is pending (A10). Scope: the pilot, as SND-D01-001. Status: pending. Owner: producer.

cues.type: foley + production dialogue (the tin and the last straw)
cues.timing: Pilot SC12-SC13, about 900-1200 s (15:00-20:00); 'Let's take a trip.' in SC12; lid opens at the end of SC13, about 1195 s (Act Two button); picture-led
cues.description: The track (SND-D01-001) plays low from the bedroom under both scenes and is carved at 1-4 kHz under every line. SC12: ice drops into two glasses, a pour follows, and the glasses are squared side by side on the white lacquered table. Her hands go still on them on a bar-1 downbeat, as the track fills the room. JEAN: “Whew!” as he blows out the drink. Her glass is set down with the straw standing in its ice. The closed metal tin slides across to him in one glide of metal on lacquer, a low, even hiss. He turns it over in his palm, and nothing inside is heard. He tries the lid, and it doesn't give under her fingertip: one dry metal tick. VENUS: “Let's take a trip.” Between lines, never under a word, the ice settles around the standing straw. SC13: after JEAN: “That's for you to find out.” the straw comes out of the ice with a wet drag and is laid flat with a wet tick. Her fingertip lifts, the catch releases, and the lid swings open toward him: a dry hinge, then a small knock at its stop, placed in a bar-4 hole so nothing covers it. Hard cut on the knock; the track carries on into SC14. Nothing inside the tin is ever heard, so the method stays off screen.
cues.licensing_or_consent_requirement: Source: foley recorded for this production (a prop tin with a hinged lid, a white lacquered table, glass, ice, straw). The dialogue is covered by the Venus and Jean actors' pilot consent. Scope: the pilot, as SND-D01-001; owned by the production. Status: pending. Owner: producer.

cues.timing: Pilot SC11-SC16: enters about 870 s (SC11, through the bathroom door) and about 905 s (SC12, her dial); plays through SC16; grid downbeat 1381.8 s; dial turn 1391.4-1394.2 s; line 1476.0-1477.6 s (proposed); hard out at the switch-off, 1496.3 s; picture-led
cues.description: The pilot's only music (A08). Venus plays it from the small white speaker on her nightstand to quiet herself; it is never score. It comes from a small mono speaker with little below about 120 Hz. Composer brief: 120 BPM in 4/4 (beat 0.5 s, bar 2.0 s), one four-bar loop of 8.0 s that repeats with no click, gap or tail at the join, written for the speaker's range. Bars 1-3: a soft four-on-the-floor kick whose attack carries the pulse, an off-beat bass pitched so its upper harmonics carry, electric-piano minor-ninth chords, a filtered pad and a low, wordless female vocal. Bar 4 (6.0-8.0 s of each loop) is the hole: kick, bass and piano drop out, leaving the pad with its filter closed down and one held low vocal note, so 1-4 kHz is nearly empty for 2.0 s. Entry, SC11: it starts low under the ice, heard through the bathroom door, the kick thumping through the wood. SC12 shows the same start from her side: the dial clicks on, and the loop begins low on a bar-1 downbeat. Through SC12-SC14 it plays on from the bedroom, carved under the lines. For SC15-SC16 the edit lays the loop so a bar-1 downbeat lands at 1381.8 s, 2.8 s after the rasp, and the staging counts 8.0 s loops from there (holes at 1379.8 s + 8n). Her dial turn, 1391.4-1394.2 s (SND-D01-002), lifts it from about 20% to about 80%. The next hole, 1395.8-1397.8 s, is the first where the pad and the held note sit over his breath. SC15's five-loop hold is 40.0 s on this grid. In SC16 every hole carries no breath. VENUS: “J. Stay for breakfast.” sits in one hole, proposed 1475.8-1477.8 s: 4 words, spoken 1476.0-1477.6 s, in about 1.6 s of the 2.0 s hole. Read: said to him, landing on 'Stay'; she is coaxing him up; not a plea, not grief. The music is laid in post, not played back on set, so the line records clean. The next hole, 1483.8-1485.8 s, is left empty: no answer. Exit: the switch-off click at 1496.3 s, 0.5 s into bar 2, stops the track hard mid-bar with no ring-out. Swap test: the hole is built for his breath, so on another film it lands on nothing.
cues.licensing_or_consent_requirement: Source: a commissioned original composition and master, with a wordless session vocalist. Scope: the pilot in all media, worldwide, in perpetuity, plus trailer, pitch and promo use of the pilot. Required: the composer's originality warranty and a similarity check, and the vocalist's written consent for that scope. No generated vocals or stems. The line is covered by the Venus actor's consent (SND-V01-015). Status: pending. Owner: producer. Not used in V01 or V02.

cues.type: voice, non-verbal + foley (Jean's breathing; the dial)
cues.timing: Pilot SC15, about 1290-1440 s (21:30-24:00); empty hole 1371.8-1373.8 s; rasp about 1379 s, placed at 1379.8 s; dial turn 1391.4-1394.2 s; picture-led
cues.description: His breathing is Jean's last sound: slow and loud, face-down, muffled by the pillow, and clearest in the track's bar-4 holes at low volume. On her side of the room, his black clothes are folded square on the white chair (cotton on cotton). In the bathroom the tap runs and her hands wash at the basin, and his breathing carries through the open door over the water. The cabinet stays shut: no catch and no pills, because SC15 shows no meds. Back in bed his breathing stops. The hole at 1371.8-1373.8 s carries only the pad and the held note, the quietest point of the night. Then his breath catches with one rasp on the inhale, at the head of the next hole (about 1379 s in the treatment; placed at 1379.8 s so nothing masks it). No gurgle and no death-rattle cliché. He breathes on, ragged, in the holes after it. Her hand passes the phone on the nightstand without touching it and turns the speaker's dial (the PR-54 volume ring) in one continuous rotation, 1391.4-1394.2 s: a soft wool rub over a faint felt-and-plastic detent. The track rises in step with her hand until his breathing sits under the pad.
cues.licensing_or_consent_requirement: Source: recorded for this production with the actor cast as Jean (not yet cast). His written consent is required for his breathing and the rasp, in the pilot scope (as SND-D01-001). No library or synthetic breath. The foley, including the dial on the PR-54 prop speaker, is owned by the production. Status: required, pending. Owner: producer.

cues.timing: Pilot SC16 after the switch-off to SC17, about 1496.3-1680 s; fitted corner about 1500 s; silent service-bay insert about 1530-1534 s; picture-led
cues.description: No music. After the switch-off at 1496.3 s the bedroom is room tone only. She sits up, and the fitted sheet's elastic snaps off her corner, the first sound after the music. SC17's 4 s service-bay insert is silent, as written: no events, no street through the roller door, no lift hum, only the faintest enclosed air so it doesn't read as a dropout. Room tone comes in hard on the cut upstairs: sealed and white, with a faint air-vent hiss. Absent: the street, neighbors and any clock. Dressing him: black cotton drawn over his arms, the white armchair's cushion sighing under his weight, and the acetate hinge of his sunglasses opened and slid on (the V01 acetate take, a plant for SC01). His canvas duffel is zipped in one pull and stood by the door. The bed: the rest of the sheets dragged off, a fresh sheet snapped open in the air, the corners pulled tight and tucked, her palms smoothing. The bathroom: the cabinet's catch, a cloth over the glass shelf, and the pill organizer lifted. Its full compartments shift once with a small dry rattle, and it is wiped under and set back square beside the amber vial, glass on glass. No label is read and no drug is named. The threshold: her knees on the hard floor, the cloth scrubbing the three drops in short hard strokes, two soft folds as the pink cloth goes square, then the bin's pedal and lid. The flat straw, dropped in on top of the cloth, lands with no sound. The tin's hinge clicks shut, and it goes into her pocket alone, with a rustle of fabric. Then the hold on the finished room with Jean in the white chair: room tone only, longer than is comfortable (tone: clean). Jean makes no sound.
cues.licensing_or_consent_requirement: Source: foley recorded for this production. The sunglasses come from the V01 acetate session. The room tones are recorded in a white-finished interior and an enclosed service bay (location releases required). Scope: the pilot, as SND-D01-001; owned by the production. Status: pending. Owner: producer.

cues.type: foley + sfx (the tag: the flip-camera press)
cues.timing: Pilot SC18, about 1680-1800 s (28:00-30:00); flip-camera press about 1750 s, the printer after it; picture-led
cues.description: This follows straight on from V01, with the same room tone, the wind through the open doorway and the open door on its stop (SND-V01-012 and 013). An acetate tick as she unhooks his sunglasses from her neckline and sets them by the oranges. Paper comes out of her bag, then two push pins go into the wall for the new man's two prints. Her chair drags to his right (the V01 chair take). Cotton as her head settles on his right shoulder, then the phone is lifted. The focal sound: her thumb squeaks to the flip-camera icon and knocks in the phone body. These are the same takes as SND-V01-004 and 008, so the ear knows the gesture, and this time there is no slide back: the press completes, heard as a 2-frame room-tone dropout. Two of her fingers lift toward his chin and stop. There is no touch, so there is no sound. The photo is taken with no shutter sound (A10). Then the palm-sized printer whirs and feeds the paper out, the only sound in the room. One more pin as the print goes up between the two walls. Then room tone and wind, and the door knocks its stop once, as in V01. Proposal, for approval: no laugh here. Every laugh so far was aimed at him from behind the lens; in front of it she only smiles.
cues.licensing_or_consent_requirement: Source: foley recorded for this production. The thumb takes are reused from the SND-V01-004 and 008 sessions, and the chair, door and room tone from the V01 room session. The printer is recorded on a debadged unit. Scope: the pilot, as SND-D01-001; owned by the production. No manufacturer UI sounds (A10). Status: pending. Owner: producer.

assumptions: Timing is in seconds from each deliverable's first frame at 24 fps, with frame = round(s x 24). CP marks the camera plan's frames as the package reviews relay them; the camera plan itself was not in this prompt. T marks a target to be spotted to the generated picture. Every hit is picture-led at ±2 unless marked sound-led.
The cut into B03 at f240 comes from the script's beat boundary and still needs to be confirmed against the camera plan.
The torso-shake frames in SH12 and SH13 were not relayed. The B06 laugh is recorded against SH12 and SH13 cut together and spotted to their shakes.

From SH22 to the end the motel door stands open at 90° (world bible PR-15 S2, as relayed) and is behind camera from SH23 (treatment SC03). The knock when it opens, at f1704, is a target, and it plants the B13 knocks.
The bag dropped in SH22 is taken to be his black canvas duffel (PR-05). If the storyboard drops her bag instead, keep the same frames with a lighter thud.
The paper sacks set down in the dark (f1730-f1742) fill the unlit frames before the lantern. The script's 'cans set down on wood' is now carried by the three paired can knocks at f1774-f1809.
V02-SH07 starts at f264, on the thumb onset, so the mic cut at f312 is SH07 f48. V02's thumb pass is quicker than V01's, so its foley is re-cut rather than lifted at V01's speed.

D01: the script has the track playing from SC11/SC12 through SC16 ('The track still plays low' in SC15). I read the treatment's 'track entry 1381.8 s' as the bar-1 downbeat its SC15-SC16 loop count starts from, not as the track's first entrance. If the treatment means a true first entrance, the director and the copywriter must reconcile it with SC11-SC15 before the music is laid. The loop is unchanged either way.

The rasp (about 1379 s in the treatment) is placed at 1379.8 s, the head of the hole just before that downbeat. The hole proposed for the line (1475.8-1477.8 s) is only a proposal; any SC16 hole on the grid before the switch-off works.
The switch-off at 1496.3 s lands 0.5 s into bar 2 of a loop, so the track stops mid-bar as designed.
The script's speaker 'dial' is the world bible's PR-54 volume ring, as relayed.
120 BPM, the 8.0 s loop and the 2.0 s hole follow the commissioner's note. The loop design is a proposal for the commission, not a spec from Lucas.
SC15 has no cabinet or meds sound, because the script keeps the cabinet shut. The meds are heard only in SC17's clean-up, as one rattle from the full organizer, and are never named.
SC17's service-bay insert is played near-silent because the script writes 'Four silent seconds'.
US vocabulary (trunk, tires, curb, organizer) follows the script's decision.
The 35mm look adds no sound. The switch from phone to film is carried by a change of mic perspective at f835.
V01 and V02 have no spoken lines (A15). The laugh is the only voice, and Jean makes no sound. Native clip audio is muted, and no generated audio is used.
V02-B01's 'wind on the mic' is a light-breeze take from the stop-sign session, because the driving wind is gone at the stop.
The picture car is generated, and its sound is recorded on a hired vintage open two-seater. That such a car can be hired is a hypothesis, and no make is identified.
The D01 cues are pilot anchors, not full coverage. Their times follow the outline and the treatment and move with the pilot edit.
The tin has a hinged lid (production design to confirm). Nothing inside it is ever heard.
Gun-handling foley uses a non-firing replica (production safety to confirm).
The 2-frame dropout at the front-camera flip is a design choice, not a claim about how any phone behaves.
Having no laugh in the tag is a proposal awaiting approval.
Loudness and delivery specs are left to the mix.
The Venus, Jean and Bartender actors are not yet cast, so every voice consent stays pending.

Taste notes followed: sound design before music (no score in V01 or V02); restraint over explanation (no stings on the eyes, gun, tin, light or title); hands before faces (hand foley leads each beat); dry over sentimental. Bent on purpose, as the script flags: the pilot's in-scene track enters mid-pilot (SC11, about 14 minutes), because SC15's climax needs it planted.

Verified facts: trance-soul music plays to quiet her; the meds are in her bathroom and untaken for weeks; dried blood behind the toilet seat; gun in her back pocket at the motel; the man in all black; the wall photos, none of them together
Craft brief: Sound Designer / Music Supervisor
Studio taste notes

evidence.specificity: An editor could lay every hit without asking a question. For example: "Her fingertips brush dust off his black cotton shirt close to the mic: stroke 1 f132-f145, stroke 2 f147-f160, each on its hand pass. On the pinch at f161 (6.71 s) the collar point creases dry, and it is pressed flat by f185 (7.71 s)." The absences are named along with the reason for each: "Absent: any hum, fridge or buzz, because there is no power." I checked the frame arithmetic throughout (f835 = 34.79 s, f1718 = 71.58 s, V02 f29 = 1.21 s) and it is correct. I held it back from 10 for two reasons. The exterior perspective in B06/B07 is left unclear ("from a roadside position" against a moving 4.5 m shot). And the tag never says where we are listening when the front camera turns on.
evidence.distinctiveness: The sound motifs could only belong to R2. The tag reuses the exact thumb takes: "These are the same takes as SND-V01-004 and 008, so the ear knows the gesture, and this time there is no slide back: the press completes." The tin stays silent: "He turns it over in his palm, and nothing inside is heard." The music is built for Jean's breath: "Swap test: the hole is built for his breath, so on another film it lands on nothing." The reveal is carried by an absence: "the missing laugh is the reveal." The one generic layer is the ghost-town set: an awning flap, a tin sign creaking on its chain, and "the swollen hinges groan" on the held frame. Any abandoned-motel film has those.
evidence.fit: The plan follows the route's sound rule to the frame: "At f835, the frame where the picture widens to 35mm, the phone mic cuts and we hear the world from outside the car." It keeps the brief's music stance: "No score and no temp track in any cut (route R2; tone: music; taste note: sound design before music)." It respects the must-avoids: the meds are "No label is read and no drug is named", the tin's contents are never heard, and no manufacturer UI sound is used. It flags the taste note it bends on purpose (the track entering mid-pilot). What keeps fit at 8 is that it adds to the script in two places. B13's written sound is "Only the wind outside, pushing at the door", and the plan adds hinge groans and two door knocks. B02's script has "the wind dropped to nothing", yet the plan has a sign creak on its chain five frames after the wind is gone. The tag also never applies the route's phone-mic rule at the payoff press.
evidence.craft: The technique is senior level. The consent terms are right: "It must allow takes to be edited and resequenced, and must exclude synthetic cloning or model training without separate written consent." The music brief is written by function and structure with correct arithmetic: "120 BPM in 4/4 (beat 0.5 s, bar 2.0 s), one four-bar loop of 8.0 s." I checked the loop holes (1379.8 + 8n) and the switch-off "0.5 s into bar 2" and both hold. It uses a real edit trick: "The bump carries the join, so the take reads as unbroken." No cue claims anything is cleared. Small errors a senior would catch on first read: the sign creaks with no wind to move it (f120 after "gone by f115"); "swollen hinges" (it is the door that swells); "exterior car passes" recorded for a tracking shot; and "2.8 s after the rasp" in SND-D01-001, while SND-D01-002 moves the rasp to 1379.8 s, which makes the gap 2.0 s.

notes.target: SND-V01-002 (the f120 sign creak) and SND-V02-001 (the stop-sign air)
notes.note: Cut the off-screen "tin sign creaks once on its chain at f120". The same cue says the wind is "gone by f115", so nothing moves the sign, and it serves no action on screen and no story event off it. Let the stop be the lumpy idle and the two collar strokes over an empty crossroads. Then give the stop one air for both cuts. The V02 cut is lifted from V01 5.5-7.0 s, so the same footage should not carry a light breeze in V02 and dead air in V01. Choose one. Either lay the same light-breeze take under V01 f115-f214 and flag "the wind dropped to nothing" to the copywriter, or play V02-B01 on idle and fabric alone and flag "Wind on the mic". Record the choice in the assumptions.
notes.source: Craft brief: "Every effect serves an action on screen or a story event off it. Cause before effect"; script V01-B02 sound ("the wind dropped to nothing") vs V02-B01 sound ("Wind on the mic")

notes.target: SND-V01-013 (B13 held frame), carried into SND-D01-003 (tag door knock)
notes.note: Bring B13 back to the script's "Only the wind outside, pushing at the door." Remove "the swollen hinges groan": the door swelled, not the hinges, and a groaning hinge over a still frame of a derelict motel is the stock haunted-motel sound. Replace the two stop knocks at f2006/f2069 with the door leaning on its stop under each gust, a soft rattle in its frame and no knock. If one knock is kept, keep only f2069 and state why. The held frame should be as still to the ear as it is to the eye. Make the same change to the tag's "the door knocks its stop once" so V01 and the pilot stay continuous.
notes.source: Script V01-B13 sound; route R2 visual language ("outside it, clean and quiet"); taste note: restraint over explanation; tone: hold the room "longer than is comfortable, like ref 05's calm next to horror"

notes.target: SND-V01-006 and SND-V01-007 (exterior car perspective, B06-B07)
notes.note: "exterior car passes ... from a roadside position" is the wrong recording for these shots. SH12 holds her laughing face at 4.5 m for several seconds, and B07 has the car "still moving", so both are tracking shots, and a roadside pass-by would Doppler and fade out. Name the perspective per shot: a follow-car or wind-shielded body-mounted exterior pair on the picture car at cruise, steady with no Doppler, for SH12/SH13; closer and lower for B07. Update the rights line from "passes" to that session. Keep a roadside pass only if the camera plan confirms SH12 is a roadside lock-off that the car drives through.
notes.source: Craft brief: "Name the source, action, material and perspective"; route R2 ("outside the phone, locked off and still")

notes.target: SND-D01-003 (the tag press)
notes.note: State where we are listening when the front camera turns on. The route's rule is phone mic while she films and the world when she lowers the phone, and "a 2-frame room-tone dropout" only makes sense inside the phone. Write it as follows. From the press, for as long as the picture is her screen, we hear the phone mic: the lantern room thin and close, her breath near the lens, no laugh, no shutter. Cut back to the room perspective when the printer whirs, so the whir lands as "the only sound in the room". This is R2's payoff, so the sound should mark the first time we are inside her front camera.
notes.source: Route R2 visual language ("Sound: the phone's mic ... When the frame widens ... heard from outside"); route central idea; A06

notes.target: SND-D01-001 and SND-D01-002 (pilot music grid and timings)
notes.note: Express the pilot anchors on the loop grid, not as absolute seconds to a tenth from a treatment that will move. The track runs continuously from the SC12 dial click, so SC12's "bar-1 downbeat" and SC13's "lid ... in a bar-4 hole" are counted from the click. The loop may be re-laid at the SC15 (LATER THAT NIGHT) and SC16 (MORNING) time cuts. So write, for example, "SC15, rasp at the head of loop n's hole; dial turn across loop n+1, bars 1-3; line in an SC16 hole" and give absolute times only as "about". Fix the internal mismatch: the rasp placed at 1379.8 s is 2.0 s before the 1381.8 s downbeat, not "2.8 s".
notes.source: Reviewer scope rule (detail that does a later department's job costs craft); craft brief: "a sync point is a target with a tolerance"

notes.note: A single unbroken laugh of 7.2 s tips toward the mania the plan's own read note rules out. Shape it as two or three phrases with audible in-breaths at named frames (for example f835-f905, breath f906-f918, f919-f985), each peak still spotted ±2 to the SH12/SH13 torso shakes, the tail gone by f1007. Let the first phrase start small and inside the exterior air, so the "first clean, quiet sound in V01" can be heard at the switch before the laugh builds over it.
notes.source: Craft brief: "Voice is a line, a window and a read ... what it must not sound like"; the cue's own read ("delight, not mania"); tone: Tender

keep: The route's perspective rule set on shared frames: phone mic out and exterior in at f835 on the widen, phone mic back at f1248 on the narrow, and "The 35mm look adds no sound."
B07's reveal by absence: "No laugh, no breath, no sting and no drone ... the missing laugh is the reveal", with only his collar fluttering over a low engine.
The flip-icon thumb squeak and body knock as a recurring motif, reused from the same takes in the tag with no slide-back this time.
The tin's silence: "He turns it over in his palm, and nothing inside is heard", which keeps the method off screen by sound as well as picture.

The trance-soul composer brief: 120 BPM, a four-bar 8.0 s loop, a bar-4 hole built for his breath and her line, the next hole left empty, and a hard switch-off mid-bar with no ring-out; the swap test is stated.
The SH10 road bump at f754 that hides the join inside B05's unbroken take.
The V02 hook: the collar pinch as the sync sound at f29 (1.21 s), and the mic cut on the same frame as the cut to black at f312.
The hard cut to digital silence on the LIMERENCE frame in both cuts, with no sting and no tail.

The straw vocabulary at the bar: a tacky tick in the wet ring, a dry slide out, a glass set down for every drink, the chimney ticking against the tin in her pocket, and the flat straw landing in the bin with no sound.

The rights practice: every cue names source, scope, status pending and the producer as owner; the laugh consent excludes cloning and model training; no generated audio, no temp track, no manufacturer UI sounds.
The named absences: no birds or insects at dusk, no hum or fridge in an unpowered room, no street or clock in the white apartment.
The proposal to have no laugh in the tag: behind the lens she laughs, in front of it she only smiles.

shots.purpose: V01-B01 (0-4 s): his head is turned to the door, and her laugh shakes the picture · must-have. Her shadow on him is the only trace of her in her own footage (R2). It lands on him only under the declared 260° sun-azimuth cheat (true 248°; the derivation is in assumptions). Method: the registered Jean element (blocker 3). The UI is composited in finishing.
shots.framing: FLOOR PLAN (LOC-01 driving north through LOC-02; car cm, x rearward from the windscreen base, y from the driver door). The axis is the road. Pos 1: Venus in the driver seat at y 32. Her skull spans car-x 88-106 (centre 97), eye 110 at x 90, crown about 121, and the low puff at her nape is flattened against the front face of her own pad at x 108. Pos 2: Jean in P1 at y 93, torso square, head turned 90° right, right cheek on the pad (x 108, y 100, pad top 108), face east to his door, right forearm slack on the door top (72). His near (left) side is 61 cm east of her head: temple x 94 (104-110 cm), ear x 93-96 (96-102 cm), jaw angle and mole x 95 (90-93 cm), collar points x 91-97 (80-86 cm), back of skull and nape x 97-108. There are no practicals. Every V01 film setup stays on or west of the centreline (y 77.5). PHONE: PR-01 upright in her right hand, wrist on the dash arc (x 25, y 55), lens at 100 cm, aimed at world 152° across his left shoulder, tilted down 5°. PICTURE: the upright 9:16 phone frame at full height, centred, 31.6% of the width, between #0A0A0A pillars that carry FL-BLACK's live 35mm grain (SH01-SH11 and SH17), so the 16:9 frame reads as one film print holding a phone picture. At his 0.85 m plane: curl tips 8% down, ear 35%, jaw 47%, mole 52%, collar points 63%; across, brow 30%, ear 58%, nape 85%. Her shadow covers car-x 77-97 at his plane: temple, ear, jaw, mole and collar points. Its rear edge crosses his head just behind the ear, about 73% across, and its top edge crosses his temple at 109 cm (24% down). Sunlit storefronts slide from frame-left to frame-right behind him. SH02-SH11 register to this frame.
shots.lens_intent: Phone rear camera, 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m with a 2x digital crop (52mm-eq; field about 0.35 x 0.62 m). This in-world lens sits outside the house set on purpose. Deep focus: collar, jaw and storefronts are all sharp, a little soft and noisy from the crop.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld by her, wrist braced on the dash. Her laugh jolts the frame at 1.8 s with rolling-shutter skew, and the frame resettles on the same framing by 4.0 s. The fast auto shutter gives crisp, staccato frames.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. DECLARED CHEAT: the sun's azimuth is set to 260° (true 248°). Its 11° height and its colour, about 4000K against an AWB of 5000K, stay true. It comes from frame-right, 18° behind the lens plane. At the true 248° her shadow would land at car-x 63-83, 10 cm ahead of his ear, on the air in front of his face; no frame of SH01-SH08 shows the sun or a horizon it could be checked against. Her head and shoulders throw one shadow across his temple, ear, jaw and collar (85-109 cm, car-x 77-97 at his plane), and her pad's shadow takes his nape below about 96 cm. Gold holds only his crown and curl tips above 109 cm, the back of his skull behind x 97 and his pad's rear rim, 6:1. Sky (10000K) fills the shade, so the shadow reads blue on black. Separation is by value: his shaded head sits against stucco 2-3 stops brighter. The sky clips flat, and the fingerprint smear hazes the brightest stucco. Film layer: grain only.
shots.action: 0-1.8 s: hold, while his crown curls lift and settle as one mass. 1.8-3.4 s: laugh jolts. The shadow's top edge bobs 3-5 cm across his temple, and its rear edge slides 3-5 cm fore and aft over his ear and the back of his skull, flashing gold there. 3.4-4.0 s: the frame settles.
shots.performance: Jean: no breath, no blink; only the wind moves him. Venus, off picture: laughing at a lover who sleeps through the best part.

shots.purpose: V01-B02 (4.0-8.9 s): at a stop sign nobody else will ever reach, her hand brushes his collar clean · must-have; source of V02-SH01. Collar C1 to C2. PR-10 stands at its world-bible mark, spun to 325° and square to this lens. Method: three layers under one sun at the declared 260° cheat (true 249°), 10° high, 3900K. (1) A practical foreground on the LOC-01 buck (rig 3a): the hand double, seated with her skull at car-x 88-106, casts her own shadow and works SH-3 on a head-and-shoulders form in P1. (2) Jean above the collar band is the registered element with a 10° sun pass, so nothing above the band moves under her touch. (3) A generated background under the same cheated sun, with 'STOP' composited if the letters distort. Risk: extra fingers, or a nod. Fallback: her hand rests on his collar.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01. The front bumper stops at x 3,096 with PR-58 just ahead. PR-10 (world x 3,088; 5.1 m south and 3.8 m east of his head; its face 2.1-2.85 m up) sits 7° to the door side of his head and 11° above it: the octagon spans about 5-30% across and 2-17% down, its top tip under the 7% bar, with 'STOP' about 8-11% down beyond his curls. Her left hand enters from frame-right about 75% down, under her own right forearm, and works the collar points at 48-64% down, 38-58% across, fingers below the jaw. Her forearm leaves frame-right at 80-88% down. Her shadow's top edge sits at 110 cm (23% down) and climbs to about 113 cm (18%) as she leans in; its rear edge holds just behind his ear.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), matching SH01 and SH04-SH06, so V02's cut from B01 to B02 lands on one frame of him. Deep focus: collar, hand, jaw and the sign at 7.3 m are all sharp.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld, wrist on the arc. The frame dips for 0.8 s as the car stops, then holds the registered frame.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. The sun at the declared 260° (true 249°), 10° high, 3900K on an AWB of 5000K, from frame-right 18° behind the lens. Her hand works inside her own shadow (car-x 77-97 at his plane), so hand and collar read as one cool plane. Gold holds his crown, curl tips and the back of his skull, 6:1. The sign's chalked face, 65° off the cheated sun, reads 1 stop under the gold on his crown. Grain only.
shots.action: f0-f18: the car stops and the frame dips; the wind drops and his curls settle within about 12 frames. f19-f35: her hand enters. f36-f64: two strokes take the collar points from dusted to black. f65-f88: she pinches the left point flat. f89-f107: her hand rests. f108-f117: as it withdraws, it crosses the lens 0.5 m out, a frame-filling blur that hides the join.
shots.performance: Unhurried and tender; her hand rests a beat before it leaves. Nothing above his collar band moves.

shots.purpose: V01-B02 tail (8.9-10.0 s): she drives on over the drift · safety (the join plate inside the hand's blur). Built from the same three layers as SH02, under the same declared 260° sun.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01, opening inside her hand's blur. The collar is in C2: points black, shoulders still dusted. Her shadow is still on him, and the sign sits at upper left.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld. The frame lurches as the car pulls about 1 m north. The sign's bearing swings from 144° to 149°, so it drifts right toward his crown (centre from 17% to 35% across, 9% to 12% down) and shrinks about 10%; its right edge may pass behind his curls.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE as SH02, under the declared 260° sun. Grain only.
shots.action: The car pulls away. The collar stays straight, and his curls lift again as the wind comes back.
shots.performance: Still but for the curls.

shots.purpose: V01-B03 jump 1 (REC 00:21:40): the same pose on the second pass through the storefronts, with her shadow higher on him · must-have. Declared 260° cheat (true 251°). Built on the registered element (blocker 3). Risk: a generator moves his head with the shadow or the wind; the locked pose prevents it.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01. Blank storefronts pass behind him on the left.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld with a small drift. The shot opens on a laugh jolt.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. The sun is about 6.5° high (true 251°, cheated to 260° as in SH01), 3400K on 5000K, from frame-right. Her shadow's top edge sits at his hairline, 114 cm (16% down), and its rear edge at car-x 97, just behind his ear, so gold holds only his curl tips and the back of his crown, 6:1. The storefronts are in full gold. Grain only.
shots.action: The shot opens mid-jolt: the shadow's top edge bobs across his hairline and settles at 114 cm within about 10 frames. Only his curls move, and dust builds toward C3.
shots.performance: His head and collar are absolutely still.

shots.purpose: V01-B03 jump 2 (REC 00:38:15): open desert, and her shadow now covers his whole near side up into the curls · must-have. Declared 260° cheat (true 254°). Registered to SH04.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01. The caliche flats slide past behind him.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld with a small drift. The shot opens on a laugh jolt.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. The sun is about 3° high (true 254°, cheated to 260°), 3000K. Her shadow's top edge sits at 118 cm (10% down). Only his curl tips catch a moving gold line, plus a strip on the back of his crown behind car-x 97. The flats are gold with long shadows, 2 stops over him. Grain only.
shots.action: The shot opens mid-jolt: gold flicks on his curl tips, then the edge settles at 118 cm. Only the background, the sun height, her shadow and his curls change.
shots.performance: His head and collar are still.

shots.purpose: V01-B03 jump 3 (REC 00:52:30): scrub hills, and he is wholly in shade · must-have. The sun is under 0.5° at a true 256° and has sunk into the dust haze on the western skyline, so the element takes its shade pass only and her shadow matte is retired. For the first time, nothing she does moves on him. Source of V02-SH02 (15.3-17.8 s).
shots.framing: Registered to SH01, with scrub hills behind him. Ear 35%, jaw 47% and collar points 63% down.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld. The frame has already settled after the laugh: only the small handheld drift remains, with no jolt in any frame.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. The sun is under 0.5° high at a true 256°, 2700K. The cheat ends with SH05, because nothing here needs her shadow. The sun sits in the dust haze on the western skyline, and on the car its light is a fraction of the sky's. The sky alone lights him, 2:1. Gold lies only on the hills 2-5 km east, which stand above the haze, 2 stops over him. Grain only.
shots.action: Only his curls move; no shadow edge touches him. A fresh film of dust is back on the brushed collar points.
shots.performance: His head and collar are still.

shots.purpose: V01-B04 (18.0-22.9 s): her thumb rests on the flip-camera icon, then leaves, played as shyness · must-have (the route idea). Practical plate B1 (rig 1, state B): the hand double's right thumb, with its 6 mm nick, over a blank phone on green, composited. Which way the screen faces awaits the director's ruling (blocker 7). Fallback: the front camera for under a second, her eyes on him.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01. Her right thumb enters nail-side from the lower right and lands on the flip icon in the bottom bar. Nothing but the thumb enters the lower-right 15%.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq). Jean is sharp in deep focus, and the thumb is sharp on the glass.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld. A laugh jolt at 4.8 s hides the plate join.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. REC 00:53:10: the sun's upper limb sits in the western haze at a true 256°, 2700K, and its light on matte surfaces is a fraction of the sky's. Jean's element takes its shade pass (sky alone, 2:1), and only the hill tops keep their gold. Plate B1: the screen's glow (6500K) keys the thumb pad from below, and the dusk dome lights the nail 1.5 stops under it, 3:1. The screen faces world 332°, 76° off the sun, so the last of it grazes the glass about 14° off its plane, from frame-right and a little behind camera. It shows only as a thin deep-red specular edge along the glossy nail ridge and the knuckle crease. The thumb reads as a dark shape over the lit picture. Grain only.
shots.action: Hold (0.8 s). The thumb slides onto the icon (1.0), rests there without pressing (2.2), then slides back to the edge (0.8). A laugh jolt follows. Behind the thumb, only his curls move.
shots.performance: Shy: a lover who won't appear in her own home video. The thumb never twitches.

shots.purpose: V01-B04 tail (22.9-26.0 s): the lens stays on him while she laughs, and the sun goes · should-have.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld. The frame shakes side to side for 1.9 s (46 frames), then settles on him for 1.2 s (28 frames). Nothing of her enters the picture; the shake is her laugh.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. The last sliver of sun (true 256°) sets and the gold lifts off the hill tops. With no sun there is no shadow of her, so the laugh shakes only the frame. The sky alone lights him, 2:1. Grain only.
shots.action: The frame shakes, then settles. Only his curls move.
shots.performance: Jean: head and collar still. Venus is off picture; her shorter laugh reads only as the shake.

shots.purpose: V01-B05 part 1 (26-29 s): blue dusk, and the phone struggles to see him · should-have. The plate join hides in SH10's exposure pop.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01. His collar barely separates from the dusk.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus, noisy at this gain.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld with a small drift. The dusk shutter is long, so every frame smears on the drift.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. The dusk dome alone lights him, 12000K on an AWB drifting to about 6500K, so it reads blue. Gain noise and compression blocks gather in the shadows, and the black collar sinks into the noise. 2:1.
shots.action: His curls keep moving. The last 0.3 s hold unchanged: her side-button press happens off picture, and nothing enters frame.
shots.performance: His head and collar are still.

shots.purpose: V01-B05 (29-34 s): the video light comes on and desert dust glints on his black collar · must-have. Collar C3. Two plates, 29.0-31.4 s and 31.4-35.4 s, are joined on a road-bump jolt at f58 (approved). The frame and the car body move, with a tyre thump on the mic, while his head, collar and sunglasses hold within a few pixels against the pad. The second plate runs on under SH11 and the opening of SH12.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01. The collar dust is the brightest detail in the picture.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld: engine vibration plus the jolt at f58. Under the LED the exposure shortens and the frames sharpen again.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. Key: PR-01's LED beside the lens, hard 5600K, with the AWB settling on it so it reads white. The collar (0.85 m) and the pad (0.95 m) sit within half a stop of each other; the door top and verge fall 2 stops down. The dust glints as specular points. Fill: the dusk dome, 12000K and blue, 8:1. The background sits 3 stops under, noisy. Grain only, with no bloom on the glints.
shots.action: The exposure pops as the light comes on, and the dust glints in the vibration. His head stays turned to the door; only his curls move.
shots.performance: His head and collar are still.

shots.purpose: V01-B06 open (34.0-34.8 s; REC 01:04:37 on these 19 frames only): the phone still holds his turned head, then starts down · must-have. Continues SH10's second plate. Over SH12 f0-f13 the plate tips toward her lap while the grained pillars open: built in finishing, no dissolve.
shots.framing: Registered to SH01: collar in C3 with the dust glinting, head turned to the door, jaw 47% down.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.85 m, 2x digital (52mm-eq), deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld. f0-f13 hold the framing. At f14-f18 a laugh jolt starts the lowering and the frames smear downward, the only smeared LED frames in V01.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE under the LED, as SH10, 8:1. Grain only.
shots.action: The dust glints and his curls move. From f14 the phone starts down toward her lap.
shots.performance: His head and collar are still.

shots.purpose: V01-B06 (34.8-39.8 s): the world as it is: the open car alone on the dusk road, and Venus laughing at the wheel with her eyes on him · must-have. Her face appears for the first time here (taste note: hands before faces). This is the first film frame outside the phone: S35 depth of field, halation, highlight roll-off and 1/48 s blur arrive as the already-grained pillars open over f0-f13. DECLARED HIGH ANGLE: the lens is at 2.4 m, so the windscreen header, 80 cm in front of her, crosses both of them at the collar and no glass lies over either face. Chosen over a low lens (about 85 cm), which would put both faces behind the glass under a reflected veil and hide her hands below the cowl, on the one face this scene earns. The cost: the horizon leaves the top of frame, and the empty road running away behind them carries 'alone' in place of the sky.
shots.framing: Full 16:9 MWS from a virtual camera ahead of the car, 4.5 m from her and 10° west of her straight-ahead line (4.43 m north and 0.78 m west of her, 46 cm outboard of the driver side), heading world 167°, looking back south. The lens is at 240 cm, tilted down 17°. Her eyeline to the lens crosses the header plane at 133 cm, 15 cm over the 118 cm header. HEADER: a hard line across the car about 54% down. It meets Venus at her collar (about 92 cm) and Jean at his (about 88 cm), so both heads and collars stand in open air above it. GLASS: 54-69% down. Through it you see the wheel top, her left hand at 10 o'clock (about 58% across, 59% down) and his forearm on the door top (about 32% across, 60% down). The cowl hides her lap and PR-01. HOOD: dusted silver, 69-100% down. The bottom edge crosses it 1.1 m ahead of the windscreen, so its front 0.7 m and the grille are out of frame. VENUS is about 55% across: crown 43%, eyes 47% and chin 51.5% down, her face about 8% of frame height. Her head is turned about 45° to him, eyeline frame-left, nose 55° off the lens, both eyes clear. Her face sits against her own bone headrest pad (top edge about 46% down), and her crown against the road beyond. JEAN is about 44% across, crown about 45% down, in P1 with his face east, 107° off the lens: a lost profile of the back of his head, the left sunglasses arm and his moving curls. The cabin spans about 32-63% across. HORIZON: out of frame. The top edge meets the ground about 158 m back. The empty blacktop runs away south behind the car toward about 72% across at the top edge, with scrub on both sides and nothing else on it.
shots.lens_intent: 35mm FF-eq (25mm S35) at 4.5 m, T2.1: sharp from about 3.3 to 7.2 m, so both faces, the header (3.7 m) and the cowl hold. The nearest thing soft is the hood's forward half at the bottom edge (2.45-3.3 m); the road softens beyond the car.
shots.camera_movement: Virtual camera locked to the car's speed, no pan. The road, the scrub and his curls carry 1/48 s blur.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK (balance 4300K). Key: the western afterglow, 3800K, soft, from frame-right. It rims her hair and left shoulder with soft halation. Fill: the 12000K dome, 4:1. The screen of PR-01, face up in her lap below the dash line, adds a faint cool uplight under her chin. Separation: her face reads against her bone pad, about a stop over her skin, and her rim halates at frame-right. Jean's black head against his pad is the darkest mass in frame, with the weave held. The asphalt sits about 2 stops under the pads; the dusk shows only as the blue cast on the road and scrub. GLASS: at the assumed 27° rake, the glass normal sits about 27° above horizontal and the view ray back to the 240 cm lens about 22° up, so the windscreen mirrors the northern dome about 31° up. That shows as a faint blue veil over the wheel and her left hand, about 2 stops under her face. The western afterglow sits about 90° off that mirror direction and never flares on the glass or the header.
shots.action: f0-f13: the grained pillars open over the tipping phone plate. She laughs, torso shaking, her left hand at 10 o'clock (seen through the glass) and her right hand on her thigh beside the recording phone, below the dash line. His curls move; nothing else on him does. Cut at 39.8 s, inside the laugh.
shots.performance: Venus: a real belly laugh, eyes on him, never on the road or a lens. Jean: still.

shots.purpose: V01-B06 tail (39.8-42.0 s): her laugh, close · should-have. The only laugh in V01 in sync. Risk: at MCU a generated mouth drifts from the recorded laugh. Method: picture-led. The laugh is generated with no audio constraint, then the recorded laugh is cut to its mouth and torso peaks (within 2 frames); there are no words, so there is no phoneme sync. Fallback: a take with her head tipped back and turned so the mouth plays off-axis.
shots.framing: MCU on the same line, 10° west of her straight-ahead line and 1.4 m from her. The lens is at 135 cm, tilted down 12°, two sizes tighter than SH12 (field 0.76 x 0.43 m). Her three-quarter sits in the frame-right third, eyes 38% down, eyeline frame-left. The header crosses soft at about 74%, under her chin. Jean's head and sunglasses arm are soft at frame-left.
shots.lens_intent: 65mm FF-eq (S35 zoom at 46mm) at 1.4 m, T2.8: about 13 cm of depth, holding her eye and lashes. Jean, 0.3 m beyond, is a soft black shape.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off. The laugh shakes carry 1/48 s blur.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK as SH12, 4:1. The rim on her hair halates softly, and her face reads against Jean's soft black shape.
shots.action: The laugh continues, then eases. His soft curls move.
shots.performance: The same laugh, eyes on him.

shots.purpose: V01-B07 part 1 (42.0-45.0 s): it is too dark for sunglasses, so she draws them off him · must-have. Practical plate (rig 3b): the hand double draws PR-04 off a still Jean double's head (back of the head only), composited, because generated glasses vanish or double. The glasses hang from her thumb and ring finger across the cut. V02-SH03 is regenerated at 9:16 on this action.
shots.framing: MWS two-shot from the SH13 position (135 cm), tilted down 10°, two sizes wider (field 1.44 x 0.81 m). Venus is frame-right, three-quarter to profile, to the waist. Jean is frame-left, back of head and glasses only. Her right hand crosses in front of his face on the windshield side, takes PR-04's left arm at the hinge and draws the frame forward along the pad, toward the windshield and the lens, while the right arm slides out from under his cheek. The header crosses the frame below the hands.
shots.lens_intent: 35mm FF-eq (25mm S35) at 1.4 m, focused at 1.6 m, T4: sharp from about 1.27 to 2.15 m. The road is soft.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off. The hand moves carry 1/48 s blur.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK, a third of a stop under SH12. The afterglow from frame-right catches her hand and the rim of the glasses; the dome fills, 4:1. Her hand reads against his black hair and the bone pad.
shots.action: Her hand goes to his face (0.8 s). She draws the glasses forward and off while his head holds against the pad (1.6). Her hand drops to jaw height, the glasses hanging open from her thumb and ring finger, index and middle fingers free (0.6). Cut as two fingers meet his chin. Only his curls stir.
shots.performance: Her laugh has stopped. Unhurried, practical, tender.

shots.purpose: V01-B07 hero (45.0-50.0 s): two fingers turn his head alone to P2. His eyes are open, pale and dusted, and they do not blink · must-have hero, the one face shot. A declared axis change, cut on action two sizes in, to a virtual bonnet position on the centreline, so the line is never crossed. His curls have moved in every shot since SH01, so the open eyes are the only new thing on him. METHOD for the hand on his face: the turn is a keyed rotation of the locked registered Jean head element about a neck pivot, over a static torso-and-collar plate, with the collar warped only where the jaw drags it. The two fingers come from a practical hand-double plate on a matched chin form, turned by a motion-control rotator playing the same curve under this shot's light (rig 3b: 3800K short-side afterglow key, 12000K dome fill, 4:1), composited so the fingertips hold contact within a few pixels. PR-04 is on the same plate, hanging from her hand. Risks: fingers slide or sink, the head leads or lags the fingers, a blink, a loll, the glasses vanish. Fallbacks: ease P1 to about 80° right (treatment); freeze the eye region from the best frame, with hair and background live. A16 fallback: the same action parked at LOC-03, never intercut.
shots.framing: CU from ahead of the windscreen, looking back south (heading world 180°). The lens is on the centreline (y 77.5), about 50 cm ahead of the windscreen base, 1.6 m from his eyes and 142 cm up: 39 cm over his eye line, so the sightline to his chin clears the 118 cm header. Tilted down 15°. No sky. The turn is 120°, through dead ahead, with his level gaze passing 14° below the lens. It stops at P2 (car-frame 240°, compass 330°) with his face about 22° off the lens toward her: a near three-quarter, near (right) cheek toward us, the far iris clear of the nose bridge. Eyes about 40% down, chin about 70%, face across 38-62%. The header lies soft across the bottom 10%. Behind his head are the bone pad, then the rear deck and the road. Her fingertips enter and leave frame-right. PR-04 hangs open by its left arm from her thumb and ring finger just below her fingers, lenses down, at about 76-92% down and 56-74% across; it swings with her hand, never touches his face, and leaves frame-right with it. His gaze exits frame-right, below and west of the lens, never within 10° of it.
shots.lens_intent: 85mm FF-eq (S35 zoom at 60mm) at 1.6 m, T2.8: field 0.66 x 0.37 m, about 10 cm of depth, holding his eyes, lashes and her fingertips. The glasses under her hand are just soft, the pad soft and the road softer. This is V01's longest lens and shallowest focus, kept for the reveal.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off. The turn and his hair carry 1/48 s blur; the eyes hold.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK. Key: the western afterglow, off frame-right, 3800K, broad and soft on his far (left) cheek and brow: short-side lighting. Fill: the eastern dome, 12000K, on his near cheek, 4:1. No source sits near the lens, so the dry corneas show only a dull sky sheen and no catchlight. His grey-ash skin is never lifted. Separation: his dark head and collar against the bone pad (about 6.8:1), the brightest area behind him. Collar dust in C3, matte. The glasses' dark lenses read against her white shirt beyond.
shots.action: Her two fingers turn his head alone on the neck, torso square, the collar dragged only at the jaw, through dead ahead to P2 with no overshoot or loll (1.8 s, stopping at 46.8 s). Her fingers rest on his chin (1.2), then withdraw frame-right with the glasses (0.4). Then his open eyes alone, crown curls moving as one mass (1.6). Her left hand stays on the wheel, out of frame.
shots.performance: Jean: the head-alone rule; no blink, no breath, lids at the top edge of the iris. Venus, hand only: no laugh. The 1.2 s rest is her beat: she already knew.

shots.purpose: V01-B08 part 1 (50.0-52.0 s): she hooks his sunglasses into her neckline, and the phone lift plays below frame, arriving as the LED pool on his face · must-have. Framed so the phone never shows and its screen's direction is never seen, pending the director's ruling on the blind screen (blocker 7). Risk: the glasses vanish or double in the hook. Method: generated. Fallback: the glasses already hooked at 50.0.
shots.framing: MS two-shot from a virtual position ahead of the car at car x -70, y 65 (12.5 cm west of the centreline), heading world 180°, straight back down the car's axis. The lens is at 158 cm, high enough that the sightline to her neckline clears the header, 1.72 m from them, tilted down 15°. Jean's eyes are about 25% across and 59% down, his gaze exiting frame-right about 20° wide of the lens. Venus's eyes are about 78% across and 55% down. Her neckline, where PR-04 hooks, is about 87% down; the header is a soft band across the bottom 6%. The bottom edge sits 26.5° below horizontal, 1.3° above the top of the phone at its dash-arc landing (27.8°), so PR-01's whole path and landing stay below frame. The dusk road runs away above their heads.
shots.lens_intent: 50mm FF-eq (35mm S35) at 1.72 m, T4: sharp from about 1.5 to 2.0 m, holding both faces and her hands. The road is soft.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off. Hand moves carry 1/48 s blur.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK as SH15, 4:1, until f38. Then PR-01's LED, arriving below frame, throws a hard 5600K pool onto his face from below and in front, 2 stops over the dusk key. It motivates SH17. The screen never enters frame.
shots.action: f0-f23: she hooks one open arm of the glasses into her neckline, lenses out. f24-f37: her right hand drops to her lap and carries the phone low along her thigh to the dash arc, below frame; only her right shoulder rises in frame. f38: the LED pool lands on his face. f38-f47: the frame closes to upright on the phone's own motion (finishing). His curls move throughout.
shots.performance: Calm, back behind the lens; her eyes stay on his face. His head is still.

shots.purpose: V01-B08 (52.0-56.0 s): REC 01:04:55 on his open eyes. Her thumb rests on the flip icon and slides back: not like this, not yet · must-have (the route idea). Plate A 4.0-5.0 s (the laugh) plus plate C 0.0-3.0 s, joined on the last laugh jolt. Thumb: practical take B2-V01 (rig 1, state A), composited over plate C. Screen ruling pending (blocker 7). PR-04 is left out of prop_ids on purpose: it hangs at her neckline, outside this picture, and a listed pair of glasses would invite a generator to put them back on his face.
shots.framing: The upright phone frame between the grained pillars. This is SH01's wrist position moved a hand's width: dash arc at car x 25, y 60, lens at 100 cm, aimed at world 154°, level. The lens is 0.84 m from his eyes (0.92 m to the pad point, x 108, y 100; his eyes at P2 sit 8-9 cm forward of it), measured to his near surface as in SH01. His face, turned to P2, sits 4° off the lens: frontal and centred, eye line 40% down, eyes across about 29-71%. His crown curls move at the top edge, his chin is about 69% down and the collar points about 84%. His face is bare. His gaze passes about 4° beside the lens toward her, frame-right. Her right thumb enters nail-side from the lower right; on the icon only its tip shows.
shots.lens_intent: Phone 26mm FF-eq at 0.84 m to his eyes with a 3x digital crop (78mm-eq; field about 0.23 x 0.41 m), generated at 4K-equivalent so V02 can punch in. This breaks the 1.2 m face rule on purpose: it is her phone at arm's length, and the slight swell is the intimacy. Deep focus.
shots.camera_movement: Handheld, wrist on the arc: a softer side-to-side laugh shake for 1.0 s, then the small drift of the settle. The LED's short exposure keeps the frames crisp.
shots.lighting: FL-PHONE. Key: the LED beside the lens, hard 5600K on a 5600K AWB, near-frontal. His dry corneas return a small dull smear, never a crisp catchlight. The background (passenger quarter and desert) falls to noise, 10:1. Take B2-V01 is lit from its own sources: the screen glow (6500K) from below keys the pad and the thumb's edges, and the dusk dome (12000K) lights the nail from above, 1.5 stops under, 3:1. The thumb reads as a dark shape over the lit picture. Grain only.
shots.action: f0-f23: laugh shake. f24-f42: the thumb goes to the icon. f43-f71: it rests (1.2 s). f72-f85: it slides back. f86-f95: hold on his eyes, no thumb.
shots.performance: A shorter rest than SH07's (1.2 s against 2.2 s): not like this, not yet. Jean: no blink.

shots.purpose: V01-B09 open (56.0-57.25 s): a time jump to the car framed between the legs of the MOTEL sign · must-have (geography). A declared jolting cut: the eye stays at centre horizontally but drops from 40% to 80-85% down, while the sign's bright face pulls it to the top. The jolt marks the time jump and the move from phone to film. Director's ruling applied: her lean dips the car about 1 cm on its springs, the car and Jean moving as one, and never during the pistol lift.
shots.framing: FLOOR PLAN (LOC-03; m, x east, y north). The car is nosed north in the carport at x 21-22.55, y 13.5-17.5. Jean sits on its east side in P2 (compass 330°, his gaze crossing the driver's seat to room 2 at x 20), right forearm on the door top; the boot is at the south end. PR-15 is at x 25.7-26.6, y 18. The office is at x 9-15, y 12-18, with its door at x 12 on the south face and PR-14 at y 11.6-12.0. The carport spans x 16-30, y 12-18, roof at 2.6 m, open along its south edge. Her worn track runs from the boot (21.8, 13.2) to the door (26.1, 18.0). The sign PR-12 is at (8, 3). Wind from the south. No practicals. Axis: the frontage, with west frame-left in every SC02 shot except SH20 and SH20B, which sit on it, and SH21, whose tripod sits under the carport. THIS SHOT: WS from across the highway at (-10, -13), lens 150 cm, bearing 48°, tilted up 8°, on the line through sign and car. The car is centred between the sign's legs, low (80-85% down), under the carport roof. The MOTEL box spans 17-31% down, with the OFFICE arrow below it and the office left of centre. Jean's black shirt (PR-56) is a dark mass in the passenger seat, his face turned from the lens. Venus's white shirt leans across him; PR-04 at her neckline is too small to read.
shots.lens_intent: 40mm FF-eq (28mm S35), focused at 30 m, T5.6: sharp from about 5 m to infinity (sign at 24 m, car at 43 m).
shots.camera_movement: Locked off.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK, sourceless: the sun is down and nothing rakes. The bright western sky (3800K against 4300K), behind camera-left, acts as a broad soft source. The sign's cream south face takes the most of it and is the brightest area, against the darker north-east dome (12000K). The stucco reads flat, and the car sits a stop darker under the roof. 2:1.
shots.action: The engine pings (0.35 s). She leans east across Jean's knees (0.9), and the car dips on its springs with him. Cut as her hand reaches the glovebox.
shots.performance: Jean is still. Venus is brisk.

shots.purpose: V01-B09 (57.25-60.0 s): she takes the pistol from the glovebox and seats it grip-up in her right back pocket, the muzzle never crossing Jean or the lens · must-have (verified fact: the gun is in her back pocket at the motel). Practical plate on the LOC-01 buck (rig 3c): Venus's body double, a still Jean double in JEAN_L02 and an inert PR-02 replica under the armourer, shot from a jib's remote head. Only the gravel and carport posts at the frame edges are extended in composite. Fallback: the pistol already in her pocket, no hand on it.
shots.framing: High MS from a remote head at (21.6, 14.4): 0.3 m behind the headrest line, just west of the centreline, 245 cm up (under the 2.6 m roof), bearing 0°, tilted down 67°. Frame-top is north (the dash), frame-right is east (the passenger door). The glovebox and its dropped lid sit about 25% down, 68% across, over Jean's knees. Her back runs diagonally to her lifted right hip, with the pocket about 86% down near centre. The pistol crosses frame centre from glovebox to pocket, muzzle toward frame-top and frame-right over the glovebox, turning muzzle-down only in the bottom fifth, over her own cushion. PR-01 is in her right front jeans pocket (S7), under her as she leans and out of view from this height; nothing rises above that pocket's mouth. PR-04 hangs from her neckline, lenses out, swinging clear of his knees under her lean. Jean is at the lower-right edge (about 75% across, 87% down): crown, black shoulders and right forearm. From this height his face stays hidden under his brow and curls.
shots.lens_intent: 29mm FF-eq (21mm S35), focused at 1.9 m, T4: sharp from about 1.33 to 3.3 m, holding the pocket, the pistol and the glovebox. Jean's crown, at the near limit, is just soft.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off. The draw carries 1/48 s blur.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK, sourceless. The roof blocks the dome. The only light is the western and southern sky through the carport's open south edge, behind camera, falling softly on her back; on stage a large soft source from that direction imitates it. Her white shirt is the brightest area, with forecourt-sky fill, 3:1. The matte black pistol reads dark against the silver-grey dash and lid, never against Jean's black; at the pocket it reads dark on pale denim, 5.5:1.
shots.action: The latch goes and the lid drops (0.4 s). She lifts the pistol by the grip, level, muzzle toward the door and dash (0.7). She draws it back across her own body, muzzle forward, as she half-straightens (0.8). Over her own cushion she turns it muzzle-down, rotating it forward and never back toward the lens, lifts her right hip and slides it grip-up into the pocket with 6 cm showing (0.85).
shots.performance: Trained handling, no flourish, even beside a dead man. Jean's knees and head do not move.

shots.purpose: V01-B10 part 1 (60.0-63.0 s): alone, she walks the frontage, tugs the padlock and starts to look down at the step · must-have. The pistol grip reads from behind. A declared setup on the axis, looking west (approved), so the grazing step takes the western sky. Her mark: toes at the step's edge. The shot ends on her look-down at f71; the unbroken dust gets its own insert (SH20B), so it reads with the sound off. Risk: generated hands fuse with the lock or open its shackle. Method: the lock, hasp and her hands are a practical element (rig 4d: the hand double on a boarded panel with a real 5 cm brass padlock, matching perspective and light), composited near the top of the generated wide; the lock is about 3% of frame height. Fallback: her hands just above frame, the lock swinging back on its hasp in frame.
shots.framing: Low WS on the axis from the gravel just east of the step at (14.5, 11.9), 10 cm off the office's south face. The lens is 35 cm up, bearing 270°, tilted up 3°. The office's south face runs almost edge-on along the right half of frame, converging toward centre and rising to frame top. The step runs away along the wall's base 1.9-3.1 m out, at about 40-53% across and 69% down, seen grazing. The padlock, about 2.3 m out, lands at about 53% across, 10% down. Frame-left holds the gravel forecourt, the empty highway's far edge on the horizon and the palm at (3, 5); the western sky fills the upper left. She passes the lens on its left walking west and enters frame-left from behind camera, her back and the grip to the lens. Her shoulders turn once toward the highway (frame-left). She stops with her toes at the step's south edge (2.5 m out, 35-45% across), turns north and leans over the step. Her hands tug the lock at top centre while her head is above frame. Once she turns north her right side faces the lens: the pistol grip 6 cm above her right back pocket and PR-01 (S7) as a flat 7 cm outline through the denim of her right front pocket, nothing above its mouth or behind the belt. PR-04 at her neckline shows only edge-on. Her boots never touch the step.
shots.lens_intent: 29mm FF-eq (21mm S35), focused at 2.5 m, T4: sharp from about 1.6 to 5.8 m, so the dust, the padlock and Venus all hold. The horizon is soft.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off on a low mount.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK, sourceless. The western horizon sky (3800K against 4300K), in frame beyond the step, is the brightest area. Seen grazing at 5°, the step's dust takes that sky as a pale sheen across its ripples: the brightest surface in the lower frame, with the gravel darker and coarser. The office face takes only the southern dome, a stop under the step. Her back takes only the dim eastern dome, 3 stops under the sky, and is rimmed by it; the grip is a dark shape where her hip crosses it.
shots.action: f0-f41: she walks in from behind camera and turns her shoulders once toward the highway (1.75 s). f42-f51: she stops with her toes at the step's south edge and turns north (0.4). f52-f66: two tugs; the lock knocks on its hasp and holds (0.6). f67-f71: she straightens and her head starts down toward the step. Cut on the look.
shots.performance: Watchful, then settled. No hurry.

shots.purpose: V01-B10 hero (63.0-64.0 s): the dust on the office step is unbroken, and her boots stop at its edge · must-have (the treatment's trigger 'seen by the camera', and the must-include check before she unloads). A cut-in on the SH20 axis, motivated by her look-down: an insert, not her POV. The step's dust fills about half the frame height, so 'untouched' reads with the sound off. Method: generated, with the step top locked from one clean plate. Risk: a generator prints a footprint or sets a boot on the step. Fallback: practical on the rig-4 stage day (rig 4e).
shots.framing: Low insert on the SH20 axis. The lens is at (13.1, 11.8), 0.5 m east of the step's east end and centred on its 40 cm depth, 37 cm above the gravel (22 cm over the step top), bearing 270°, tilted down 14°. The step's dusted top runs away from the lens: its near (east) end is about 80% down, spanning 11-89% across; its far (west) end is about 30% down, spanning 39-61%. The dust fills 30-80% of frame height. Below it, the upper half of the step's concrete east face fills the bottom 20%. Frame-right: the office's south face, 20 cm off the lens, runs edge-on from the right edge to the horizon at centre, with the plywood-boarded door's base on it at about 62-80% across. Frame-left: Venus's boots and jeans hems stand on the gravel at about 22-34% across, 40-64% down. Her toes point frame-right, stopped at the step's south edge line (about 32% across at her distance), never over it. The horizon is about 7% down, with the western sky across the top-left strip. No print anywhere on the step.
shots.lens_intent: 35mm FF-eq (25mm S35) from the SC02 set, focused at 0.9 m, T11 (a generated plate, so the stop sets the depth, not the exposure): sharp from about 0.65 to 1.5 m, which covers the step from about 33% to 64% down and her boots at 1.13 m. The nearest thing soft is the step's near end (64-80% down); its last 20 cm and the gravel beyond soften toward the horizon.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off on a low mount.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK, sourceless. The western sky in the top-left strip (3800K against 4300K) is the brightest area, and it backlights the step at 6-24° grazing. Each ripple crest catches it as a pale line with a thin shadow on its lens side, so the unbroken ripples read as fine parallel lines across the whole top: the brightest surface in frame after the sky. The gravel beside the step is coarser and darker. Her brown-black boots and denim hems read as dark shapes against the pale dust, rimmed on their west edges by the sky. The office face, edge-on at frame-right, takes only the southern dome, 2 stops under the dust. 3:1 on the ripples.
shots.action: Nothing on the step moves. Her boots hold at its edge while she looks down.
shots.performance: Her feet are settled: she has what she came to check.

shots.purpose: V01-B11 part 1 (64-68 s): she unloads his bag, her bag and the groceries while he stays in the seat · must-have. The four loads fill all 96 frames, so she does not exit; the shot ends on her turn toward frame-right (the door), which carries screen direction into SH22. The director's ruling holds: the raised lid never hides the count of two bags and two sacks, and Jean shows only the back of his head. The tripod at (25.6, 12.2) sees his head about 30 cm clear of the lid's east edge. Both sacks are rolled shut: their contents (PR-07's cans, jugs, oranges and printer) stay inside, unseen, and none of them is listed here. Risk: the bag count changes across the cut, or the sacks crush the sunglasses at her neckline.
shots.framing: Her mark: the rear bumper at (21.8, 13.1), facing north into the boot. MWS from under the carport's open south edge: tripod at (25.6, 12.2), lens 140 cm, bearing 292°, tilted down 5°. Venus is about 35% across, full figure, seen from her right side, face turned into the boot. PR-04 hangs at her neckline, lenses out, in profile. PR-01 (S7) reads as a flat 7 cm outline through the denim of her right front pocket, nothing above its mouth or behind the belt, and the pistol grip stands 6 cm above her right back pocket. The boot opening spans about 46-66% across, with the raised lid at 54-66%; the loads lift out in front of the lid, never behind it. The two kraft sacks stay rolled shut, with nothing showing above their tops. Past the lid's east edge, about 71% across, is the back of Jean's head (face hidden), his black right shoulder (PR-56) and his forearm on the door top. Behind her, 10.9 m out, is the office's east face. The start of her worn track runs along the bottom of frame.
shots.lens_intent: 35mm FF-eq (25mm S35), focused at 3.6 m, T4: sharp from about 2.3 to 8.5 m (Venus at 3.9 m, Jean at 4.3 m). The office face goes soft.
shots.camera_movement: Locked off.
shots.lighting: FL-DUSK, sourceless. She stands 1 m inside the carport's open south edge; her back and right side take the south-west glow through it, with forecourt dome (12000K) fill, 3:1. Behind her, the office's east face sits 1.5 stops down under the roof, so her white shirt reads about 2 stops over it. Her arms read against the dark raised lid; Jean reads dark against the shaded driver side. The pale denim carries the phone outline and the dark grip by value.
shots.action: Lid up (0.8 s). His black bag onto her left shoulder (1.1). Her bag onto her right (1.0). Both sacks hugged low against her ribs, their rolled tops just under PR-04, as she turns from the boot toward frame-right (1.1). The boot is left open. His curls stir; nothing else on him moves.
shots.performance: Fast, one trip, and she never looks back at him.

shots.purpose: V01-B11 part 2 (68-72 s): at the end of her worn track she shoulders the swollen door open and goes into the dark still laden · must-have. The track is the scene's one real detail: she has lived here for weeks (A14). The doorway sits at the left third (approved). Per the review notes, the bags reach their marks off screen in the SH22-SH23 elision, away from the SH25/S02 lens. f20-f95 is the practical doorway pass on the partial LOC-04 set (rig 4a).

shots.purpose: V01-B12 part 1 (72.0-78.25 s): the lantern click reveals the wall of him while her hands unpack, printer first; then one look across the table toward the bare boards where his chair will go, beside hers · must-have (taste note: hands before faces). For those 0.9 s her dark crown rises into print C13-R1 (wall C, column 13 from wall B, row 1 from the floor: x 225-240, 95-105 cm), so she is inside a photograph of him as a shape, not a face: the same rule as her shadow on him in the car.
