shots.purpose: S01 key art, 2:3: Venus laughing at the wheel, her phone showing Jean as phone video, and the real Jean beside her, pale and still in golden light · must-have. Planned on option C, which Lucas chooses between (blocker 8): the southbound graded-track leg at REC about 00:12, sun 9° high at a true 249°, 3700K. Heading south in a left-hand-drive car, the low west sun lands on Jean's side, so no azimuth cheat is needed here. The sun sits within a few degrees of the lens plane on frame-right, so a side flag is named (see lighting). DECLARED VIEWPOINT CHANGE: the route and the stills copy ask for 'behind her right shoulder', but from there her face reads only as a cheek line and his profile hides behind the pad. The lens moves behind his right shoulder, outboard on his door side. There are two declared phone cheats (see framing). The screen is turned to 20° off our axis so the second Jean survives a deck thumbnail, and a chroma lock keeps the real Jean pale in full gold (its cost is logged in blocker 8). This breaks 'hands before faces' on purpose, because a poster needs its lead. LIMERENCE only, in the top 15%. His eyes and neck mole stay hidden to protect V01's reveal. The screen needs a one-off phone frame, because V01 never shows this leg.
shots.framing: 2:3 still from behind the car (heading 180°). The lens is at car x 280, y 150 (5 cm inside his door line, 72.5 cm outboard of the centreline), 155 cm up, off eye level to see over the pads, heading world 155°, tilted down 12°. VENUS, 2.19 m out, sits about 30% across, eyes about 49% down. Her nose is at 272°, looking straight at him and held within 95° of the direction of travel (92°), which puts it 55° off the lens: a right three-quarter, tipped back laughing, with her far iris at the nose bridge. Her eyeline passes just under the phone's lower edge to him, never to the lens. JEAN, 1.8 m out, sits about 71% across in P1, facing 270° (his door, into the sun), 73° off his nose: a deep profile of brow, lens rim, nose tip, grey-ash lips and jaw. His temple-to-jaw plane clears the pad's west edge by at least 6 cm, his eyes stay behind the lens and the cheek line, the mole is on his far side, and his crown curls lift rearward. His forearm on the door top lies out of frame-right (continuity holds). The horizon is about 29% down: the graded track running south, scrub, hazy hills at frame-left, and dusk-gold sky in the top 15% for the title. PHONE CHEATS, declared. (1) PR-01 is in her right hand between their heads at car x 100, y 70, 115 cm, centred at about 52% across and 49% down. Truly aimed at him, its screen would face her (about 106°). It is turned about 110° to face world 356°, 20° off our axis, so 6.8 cm of its 7.2 cm width shows: about 5.2% of frame width and 7.7% of frame height. That is large enough to read as a second, upright Jean at deck-thumbnail size. (2) Its picture is a one-off frame taken from the dash arc.
shots.lens_intent: 35mm FF-eq (25mm S35), a 2:3 extraction (16.5 x 24.8 mm on the S35 4-perf gate, camera rolled), focused at 1.95 m, T4: sharp from about 1.49 to 2.83 m, holding Jean (1.8 m), the screen (1.97 m) and her eyes (2.19 m). The desert is soft.
shots.camera_movement: A single still frame.
shots.lighting: FL-GOLD (balance 5600K). The sun is at a true 249°, 9° high, 3700K, from frame-right. It sits 94° off the lens axis in azimuth, about 96° counting the 12° tilt and its height: within a few degrees of the lens plane. FLAG: a frame-right side flag (an eyebrow on the matte box's right edge, set on the sun line) keeps it off the front element and the matte-box edges. Acceptance: no flare, veil or sun streak from the frame-right edge. Jean faces 270°, 21° off the sun, which sits on his left: hard gold across the front planes of his profile (brow, lens rim, nose, grey-ash lips, jaw). His cheek against the pad falls to shade, filled by the sky (10000K) and bounce off the bone leather, 6:1. Venus's nose is at 272°, 23° off the sun, which is also on her left, while the lens sits 55° to her right. Gold falls across the front of her face and her far cheek, and her near cheek turns into the edge of the light (short lighting), filled by the leather and her white shirt, 3:1. Her hair edge halates softly. PALLOR LOCK, measured after the film pass on matched patches of each sunlit cheek: his CIELAB chroma is no more than half of hers. His lips and lids hold the grey-ash hue at C* 8 or under. No skin secondary, warm window or grade move touches him, and any warmth on her is keyed to her alone. The gold lights his shape, never his colour; his skin is never lifted. Separation: his lit profile against the silver bonnet beyond, which the 9° sun only grazes (1-1.5 stops under); her dark hair and halated edge against sunlit caliche. SCREEN: a plain lit panel carrying the dash-arc frame of his collar, left jaw, ear and sunglasses arm in cool shade with a thin gold rim, in the phone look, with the REC dot, no timer and no trace of her: two of him, none of her. It is keystoned to 20°, 1 stop under her hair rim and below the halation threshold. It faces 356°, 107° off the sun, so no sun reaches the glass; it reflects only the shaded rear deck behind the seats, held under the picture.
shots.action: She laughs, holding the phone on him. He is still.
shots.performance: Venus: the real laugh, in love, beside a dead man. Jean: absolute stillness.

(4) SH24 no longer claims halation from the lantern. Its globe is out of frame above the tabletop, and halation comes only from highlights inside the frame.

Carried from the previous version. (1) SUN. It is computed for the story's date, Friday 23 October 2026 (the style bible's VENUS_L03; the evening after PR-36's 10/23/2026 01:47:12 frame), at about 34°N. The true azimuths are 248° at 11° high, 249° at 10° and 9°, 251° at 6.5°, 254° at 3° and 256° at sunset. At those azimuths her shadow misses him (derivation below), so a 260° azimuth cheat is declared for the sunlit phone plates SH01-SH05 and for rig 3a. SH06-SH08 play true, with the disc in the western haze, and SH06 plays wholly in shade. S01 plays at a true 249°, with a frame-right side flag named. (2) PROP IDs. SH21 lists neither PR-22 nor any other sack contents, because both sacks are rolled shut. PR-01 in state S7 (a flat 7 cm outline in her right front jeans pocket) is listed where her right side or front faces the lens (SH20, SH21, SH22, SH24) and in SH19, where it is stated as out of view. (3) NUMBERS. SH12's windscreen mirrors the northern dome about 31° up. SH17 and V02-SH05 to SH07 are measured at 0.84 m to his eyes; 0.92 m is the distance to the pad point (x 108, y 100).

Projection method for the SC03 positions. Each point is carried into camera space with the lens's yaw and pitch, then mapped with the 50mm FF-eq half-frame tangents (0.36 across, 0.2025 down for 16:9). Heights used: tabletop 74 cm, lantern 74-99 cm, cans stacked to 107 cm, full jugs to 101 cm, chair seats 45 cm and top rails 88 cm, chair backs about 20 cm north of the seat centres (y 440). The lantern globe sits at about 88 cm for the light lines: PR-18's and PR-19's backs are lit above about 58 cm, where the ray from the globe clears the table's north edge, and their seats sit in the tabletop's shadow.

Sun and her shadow, SC01 (derivation). Declination about -11.6°. The true sun by REC time: 00:00:04, 11° at 248°, about 4000K; 00:06:12, 10° at 249°, 3900K; about 00:12 (S01), 9° at 249°, 3700K; 00:21:40, 6.5° at 251°, 3400K; 00:38:15, 3° at 254°, 3000K; 00:52:30, under 0.5° at 256°; 00:53:10, the upper limb on the horizon at 256°. The sun descends about 12° an hour, which holds the timeline's elevations. VENUS'S HEAD: her skull spans car-x 88-106 (centre 97), eye 110 at x 90, crown 121. The low puff at her nape is flattened against the front face of her own pad at x 108, and the pad is about 8 cm deep (assumed; blocker 5). JEAN'S NEAR (LEFT) SIDE, at y about 93, 61 cm east of her head: temple x 94 (104-110 cm), ear x 93-96 (96-102 cm), jaw angle and mole x 95 (90-93 cm), collar points x 91-97 (80-86 cm), back of skull and nape x 97-108. GEOMETRY: a shadow that reaches his plane moves forward by 61 x tan(the sun's angle south of west) and drops by 61/cos(that angle) x tan(elevation). At the true azimuths the forward shift runs from 25 cm (248°) down to 17.5 cm (254°). Her silhouette (x 88-108) therefore lands at x 63-83 at first and x 70-90 at SH05, its rear edge 10 cm to 3 cm ahead of his ear, on the air in front of his face and on his door top. It misses him. DECLARED CHEAT: the azimuth is set to 260° for SH01-SH05 and for rig 3a, while elevation and colour stay true. At 260° the shift is 10.8 cm, so her shadow spans x 77-97 at his plane and covers his temple, ear, jaw angle, mole and collar points. Its rear edge falls just behind his ear, about 73% across the phone frame, and leaves the back of his skull in sun; her pad's shadow takes his nape below about 96 cm. The top edge is 121 - 61.9 x tan(elevation): 109 cm (SH01), 110 cm rising to 113 cm in SH02's lean, 114 cm (SH04) and 118 cm (SH05). The cheat is safe: no frame of SH01-SH08 shows the sun, a horizon or a cast shadow long enough to read its bearing, and the background plates take the same cheated sun. From SH06 the disc sits in the dust haze on the western skyline and its light on the car is a fraction of the sky's, so the element takes its shade pass. The hills 2-5 km east stand above the haze and keep their gold until SH08. SH07's graze stays true: the screen faces 332°, which is 76° off the sun at 256°, so the light arrives 14° off the glass. It reads only as a specular edge on the glossy nail, which is why it can show while Jean's matte skin takes the shade pass.

S01 sun geometry. At a true 249° and 9° high, the lens axis (155°, tilted down 12°) sits 94° from the sun in azimuth, and about 96° once the tilt and the sun's height are counted. That puts the sun 4-6° behind the lens plane, within a few degrees of it, where the curve of the front element and the matte-box edge can catch it. That is why a frame-right side flag is named, with 'no flare from the frame-right edge' as the acceptance check. Jean faces 270°, 21° off the sun, which sits on his left. Venus's nose is at 272°, 23° off the sun, also on her left, and the lens is 55° to her right, so her near cheek is the shadow side (short lighting). The screen faces 356°, which is 107° off the sun.

SH12's declared high angle (240 cm, tilted down 17°). At about 85 cm both faces would sit behind the glass under a reflected veil, and her hands would drop below the cowl. 17° rather than 16°, because at 16° the horizon sits on the top edge (the vertical half-angle is 16.13°). At the assumed 27° rake the glass normal sits 27° up and the view ray back to the lens about 22° up, so the glass mirrors the northern dome about 31° up, about 89° from the western afterglow.

Tilts. Each tilt is computed to hold its stated frame positions: SH15 15° (eyes about 40% down), V02-SH04 16° (eyes about 40%), SH16 15° under its constraint, SH13 12° (her eyes at 38%), SH12 17° (her eyes at 47%, horizon out of frame), SH23 17° down, SH24 2° up. With the lens above his eyes, less tilt would drop the eyes lower in frame.

Header clearance. SH12 at 240 cm: her eye sightline passes 15 cm over the 118 cm header and her chin line 5 cm over it. SH15 at 142 cm: the chin line clears the header by about 3 cm. V02-SH04: the header crosses at about 68%. SH16 at 158 cm: the header is clear down to her neckline. All of this assumes the header sits about 15 cm behind the windscreen base (a rake of about 27°) and about 80 cm in front of her eyes (blocker 5). If the reference model differs, the clearances are the target, not the heights.

SH16 geometry. Seen from ahead of the car, her neckline and the phone at the dash arc sit only about 4° apart. A frame that shows the hook and hides the phone therefore needs a lens high enough to clear the header (158 cm) and a bottom edge at 26.5°, 1.3° above the top of the phone. 50mm is the widest lens that keeps both faces in and the phone out.

SH20B geometry. The lens is at (13.1, 11.8), 37 cm above the gravel and 22 cm over the step top, facing 270°, tilted down 14°. The step's near edge (0.5 m out) is 23.7° below the lens and lands about 80% down; the far edge (1.7 m out) is 7.4° below and lands at about 30%. The horizon lands about 7% down. Her toes at about (12.0, 11.58) are 1.13 m out. At T11, focused at 0.9 m, sharp focus runs from 0.65 to 1.5 m; it is a generated plate, so the stop is a depth choice.

Bag marks. I followed the world bible (PR-05 S7, PR-06 S4) and the treatment: the bags lie west of the latch jamb (x 195-245, y 10-50), outside the SH23, SH25 and S02 frames. At SH25's stated 350°, PR-23 lands about 71-77% across and 84-99% down.

Lucas's 35mm direction (binding) is one film pass over everything. It has fine 35mm negative grain, strongest in the shadows and mids; red-orange halation above about +2.5 stops over mid-grey; a soft highlight shoulder from about +2 stops; a #0A0A0A black floor, deep but not crushed, so Jean's weave holds; film colour that desaturates as highlights climb; and skin hues held within about 3° and never lifted. Depth and perspective come from real S35 focal lengths at stated distances, never from a blur pass. Everything runs at 24 fps with a 180° shutter (1/48 s) and no slow motion. The pass goes on last, natively at each output's resolution, with grain clumps at 0.10% and halation spread at 0.5% of the short side, and the same threshold, shoulder and floor everywhere. V02 is never a crop of graded V01: V02-SH03 and SH04 are regenerated on the rolled S35 gate. The stills take the pass at master size, and S01's pallor lock is measured after the pass.

Phone versus film, decided on purpose. Her footage stays phone video, because it is her way of seeing him. Inside the phone picture: 26mm-eq deep focus with digital crops, hard-clipped highlights, a drifting AWB, gain noise and compression at dusk, rolling-shutter skew, fingerprint haze and the phone's own shutter; the film pass adds only grain there. Halation, roll-off, S35 depth and 1/48 s blur arrive only at SH12, so the split reads with the sound off. The whole frame is still film: V01's pillars and V02's 3% surround carry FL-BLACK's live grain, and the whole frame (surround and picture as one unit) carries the same gate weave. In V02 the surround opens to full bleed on the two film shots (SH03-SH04) and closes at SH05. Screens seen inside film frames (S01) are plain panels, with the phone picture composited below the halation threshold.

Look codes. FL-PHONE: AWB about 5000K in gold light, drifting to about 6500K at dusk and locking to about 5600K on the LED; sun at the declared 260° for SH01-SH05, true from SH06. FL-GOLD: balance 5600K, sun 3700K at a true 249°. FL-DUSK: balance 4300K, afterglow 3800K, dome 12000K, no hard source. FL-LANTERN: balance 4300K, lantern 2700K. FL-CANDLE: balance 3200K, flame 1900K, sconces 2400K. FL-BLACK: #0A0A0A with live grain.

Lens convention. Each lens is given as its full-frame equivalent from the house set, then the real S35 length (about FF / 1.45). Depth of field uses the T-stop as the f-number and a 0.025 mm circle of confusion. Phone fields use the full-frame diagonal (43.3 mm) on the 9:16 picture: SH01's 52mm-eq at 0.85 m gives 0.35 x 0.62 m; SH17's 78mm-eq at 0.84 m gives about 0.23 x 0.41 m; V02's 133mm-eq at 0.84 m gives about 0.13 x 0.24 m. Phone distances are measured to his near surface, as in SH01. Lenses per scene: SC01 uses 35, 50, 65 and 85 (the phone's 26mm-eq is an in-world lens and isn't counted); SC02 uses 29, 35 and 40; SC03 uses 25 and 50; SC08 uses 40.

Frames, all at 24 fps; stills are logged at 24 with duration 0. V01: 27 shots, 2160 frames (B01 96, B02 144, B03 192, B04 192, B05 192, B06 192, B07 192, B08 144, B09 96, B10 96 = SH20 72 + SH20B 24, B11 192, B12 240, B13 144, B14 48). V02: 8 shots, 360 frames (36+60+24+24+72+48+48+48). No generated plate runs over 5 s.

Eyes plate map. The phone holds one position for the eyes: wrist on the dash arc at car x 25, y 60, lens at 100 cm, 0.84 m from his eyes (0.92 m to the pad point), aimed at world 154°, 3x crop, LED 5600K, generated at 4K-equivalent. Plate A (5.0 s): the eyes hold at 0.0-3.0 s (V02-SH05) and the laugh shake runs at 3.0-5.0 s (V02-SH06; V01-SH17 uses 4.0-5.0). Plate C (5.0 s): the settle (V01-SH17 uses 0.0-3.0; V02-SH07 uses 2.6-4.6). No frame appears twice within V02.

Registered Jean element (SH01-SH06; SH02-SH03 above the collar band; the SH15/V02-SH04 turn). It is one locked pose, rendered as a full-sun pass at each sun height, at the declared 260° azimuth, plus a sky-shade pass. The passes blend through a matte of her shadow that moves 3-5 cm with her laugh jolts and climbs with her lean in SH02 (SH01-SH05); SH06 takes the shade pass alone. His crown curls are one animated layer shared by all passes: they move in every moving shot, go still about 12 frames after the stop in SH02, and lift again in SH03. For SH15 the same element rotates about a neck pivot over a static torso plate.

Geography. SC01: the road is the axis. Every film setup sits on or west of the centreline, and the change at 45.0 s is cut on action to a centreline position. SH12 and SH13 share one line 10° west of her straight-ahead; SH15, SH16 and V02-SH04 look straight back down the car (heading 180°). In SH15-SH17 his gaze exits frame-right, toward her, never within 10° of the lens. SC02: west is frame-left, except SH20 and SH20B, which sit on the axis looking west; she turns toward frame-right at the end of SH21 and enters frame-left in SH22. SC03: the camera is always south or south-east of the table; PR-18 holds its S1 mark through SH23-SH26, and PR-19 moves only on screen in SH24. In SC01 the camera is handheld only when it is her hand (the phone); every other shot is locked off, with no drone and no push.

Upstream clashes, named. (a) The head turn: the treatment and world bible turn him 120°, casting says about 60°; I followed the treatment. (b) Venus works from the table's south-east corner, not the treatment's south edge, which would block every south lens. (c) The route's 'clean' look outside the phone becomes film texture. (d) The route's sun flaring on the phone's lens becomes fingerprint haze, because the sun can't reach that lens; S01's sun is flagged off the lens. (e) B09 splits into SH18 and SH19, and B10 into SH20 and SH20B. (f) PR-01 S4 lifts her wrist in B02; I keep it on the arc so SH02 registers. (g) SH22 goes into the dark still laden, where the treatment has her shrug the bags off at the jamb. (h) SH25 opens after a declared elision, and its lens sits in the doorway plane. (i) V02-SH03 and SH04 are regenerated rather than cut. (j) S01 is set on a leg V01 never shows, from behind Jean's right shoulder, with the phone turned about 110°. (k) The SH12-SH14 plate boundaries differ from the treatment's; each plate is 5 s or less. (l) In SH16 the phone lift plays below frame, pending blocker 7. (m) SH12's 2.4 m height is my choice (blocker 7's companion list, blocker 6). (n) The sun is placed as the style bible's date gives it; its azimuth is cheated only for SH01-SH05 and rig 3a, and declared.
Dead-eye light: no source sits near any lens that sees his eyes, so the corneas carry a dull sheen (SH15, V02-SH04) or a dull LED smear (SH17, V02-SH05 to SH07), never a crisp catchlight.

Taste notes. Hands before faces is followed: her face first appears at SH12, and his only at SH15 and inside her phone. S01 breaks it on purpose, because a poster needs its lead. One real detail per scene: the stop sign (SC01), the worn track and the unbroken step (SC02), the printer (SC03). Restraint over explanation: her shadow climbing him in SH01-SH05 and her crown inside C13-R1 in SH23 carry the idea with no words. The craft rules are broken on purpose twice. Face close-ups sit at 0.84-0.85 m, because it is her phone at arm's length. The phone UI follows the label rule: a blank screen in the plate, with the art composited later (clearance pending, A10).

IDs. PR-10, PR-11 and PR-58 are LOC-02 props that appear in LOC-01 shots, because the location is the moving car. PR-04 and PR-01 appear in LOC-03 and LOC-04 shots on Venus, as the world bible lists them (PR-04 S5, PR-01 S7). PR-18 appears in every SC03 shot that sees the table's north side (SH23-SH26, S02). No new character, look, location or prop is introduced; the chin form, padlock panel and step form are rig elements, not story props. Lucas's reference images were not inspected; they are used only as the brief describes them, and no character is modelled on any face.

blockers.issue: The practical plates need a stage day. Everything else is generated from virtual positions, so no rigged car and no road-safety sign-off are needed.
blockers.resolution: LIGHT AND CAMERA PER RIG. Crew and schedule are the producer's. The light states below are listed in an order that keeps each rig to one change. RIG 1, GREEN PHONE: a blank phone on green at the phone's pose, the camera square to the glass and framing the full screen height. State A: a 6500K panel under the glass (screen glow) plus a soft 12000K top on the nail, 3:1. Shoot B2-V01 (ends on the bottom-bar icon, SH17) and B2-V02 (enters the bottom edge about 78% across and rests on V02's icon mark, V02-SH07), both long with handles. State B: state A plus a small hard 2700K source about 14° off the glass (the true 256° sun against the screen's 332°), from frame-right and a little behind camera, flagged so it shows only as a thin specular edge on the nail ridge and knuckle crease. Shoot B1 (V01-SH07). RIG 2, TABLETOP (a LOC-05 counter section, top 107 cm): S03. The live candle (about 1900K) is the key beyond the house, with the red neon practical and a soft 2400K fill behind camera, 8:1. Camera rolled for 4:5 at 225 cm, 55 cm east of the house, down 65°, 40mm FF-eq, T2.8. RIG 3, LOC-01 BUCK at world-bible heights. 3a, SH02-SH03: a hard 3900K sun from the driver side, 10° high at the declared 260° cheat (10° rearward of square; the true sun is 249°), plus a soft 10000K top. The hand double sits with her skull at car-x 88-106, eye 110, so her own shadow falls on the form's ear, jaw and collar points (car-x 77-97 at his plane). Camera at the phone's lens point (dash arc, 100 cm, world 152°, down 5°, 52mm-eq). SH-3 is dusted to C1 on a P1 head-and-shoulders form. 3b: kill the sun; set a 12000K dome and a large soft 3800K source at the west front, 4:1. SH14 at the SH13/SH14 position (135 cm, 1.4 m, 35mm FF-eq), with a still Jean double seen from the back of the head only. SH15 finger plate at the SH15 position (centreline, 1.6 m, 142 cm, down 15°, 85mm FF-eq) on a matched chin form, turned by a motion-control rotator playing the turn curve, with PR-04 hanging from the hand double's thumb and ring finger; also shot on the rolled gate for V02-SH04. 3c: fly a black roof flag at 260 cm and keep one large soft source from the south rear, 3:1. SH19 from a jib remote head at 245 cm, down 67°, 29mm FF-eq, with the inert PR-02 replica. RIG 4, PARTIAL LOC-04 SET: wall A with PR-15, its exterior dressed as the frontage with the patch and the track, plus the table, lantern, both chairs at their SH23 marks (PR-18 at (150, 420), PR-19 against wall D) and the lower strip of wall C. One soft 12000K source outside wall A throughout. 4a, SH22 doorway pass f20-f95: the SH22 tripod point, 100 cm, 350°, 35mm FF-eq, lantern off. 4b, SH23: (240, 160), 160 cm, 347°, down 17°, 50mm FF-eq, with PR-16 switched on in shot. 4c, SH24: a low mount at 55 cm, 325°, tilted up 2°, 50mm FF-eq; PR-18 stays on its S1 mark. 4d, the SH20 padlock element: a boarded plywood panel with a hasp and a real brass padlock; camera 2.3 m out and 35 cm up, looking up at the lock as in SH20, 29mm FF-eq; a soft 12000K source from the south on the panel face and a bright soft 3800K backdrop to the west, 3:1. 4e, SH20B fallback only: a 120 x 40 x 15 cm concrete step form against a stucco flat, dressed with sifted caliche raked into wind ripples, with the Venus body double's boots at its south edge. Camera 37 cm up, 0.5 m off its east end, facing along it, down 14°, 35mm FF-eq, T11. A low, bright, soft 3800K backdrop beyond its west end rakes the ripples, with a soft 12000K top from the south, 3:1.

panels.camera_movement: Handheld by her, wrist braced on the dash. Her laugh jolts the frame at 1.8 s with rolling-shutter skew, and the frame resettles on the same framing by 4.0 s. The fast auto shutter gives crisp, staccato frames.
panels.lighting: FL-PHONE. DECLARED CHEAT: the sun's azimuth is set to 260° (true 248°). Its 11° height and its colour, about 4000K against an AWB of 5000K, stay true. It comes from frame-right, 18° behind the lens plane. At the true 248° her shadow would land at car-x 63-83, 10 cm ahead of his ear, on the air in front of his face; no frame of SH01-SH08 shows the sun or a horizon it could be checked against. Her head and shoulders throw one shadow across his temple, ear, jaw and collar (85-109 cm, car-x 77-97 at his plane), and her pad's shadow takes his nape below about 96 cm. Gold holds only his crown and curl tips above 109 cm, the back of his skull behind x 97 and his pad's rear rim, 6:1. Sky (10000K) fills the shade, so the shadow reads blue on black. Separation is by value: his shaded head sits against stucco 2-3 stops brighter. The sky clips flat, and the fingerprint smear hazes the brightest stucco. Film layer: grain only.

DECLARED HIGH ANGLE: the lens is at 2.4 m, so the windscreen header, 80 cm in front of her, crosses both of them at the collar and no glass lies over either face. Chosen over a low lens (about 85 cm), which would put both faces behind the glass under a reflected veil and hide her hands below the cowl, on the one face this scene earns. The cost: the horizon leaves the top of frame, and the empty road running away behind them carries 'alone' in place of the sky.

panels.purpose: V01-B07 hero (45.0-50.0 s): two fingers turn his head alone to P2. His eyes are open, pale and dusted, and they do not blink · must-have hero, the one face shot. A declared axis change, cut on action two sizes in, to a virtual bonnet position on the centreline, so the line is never crossed. His curls have moved in every shot since SH01, so the open eyes are the only new thing on him. METHOD for the hand on his face: the turn is a keyed rotation of the locked registered Jean head element about a neck pivot, over a static torso-and-collar plate, with the collar warped only where the jaw drags it. The two fingers come from a practical hand-double plate on a matched chin form, turned by a motion-control rotator playing the same curve under this shot's light (rig 3b: 3800K short-side afterglow key, 12000K dome fill, 4:1), composited so the fingertips hold contact within a few pixels. PR-04 is on the same plate, hanging from her hand. Risks: fingers slide or sink, the head leads or lags the fingers, a blink, a loll, the glasses vanish. Fallbacks: ease P1 to about 80° right (treatment); freeze the eye region from the best frame, with hair and background live. A16 fallback: the same action parked at LOC-03, never intercut.

panels.lighting: FL-GOLD (balance 5600K). The sun is at a true 249°, 9° high, 3700K, from frame-right. His cheek against the pad falls to shade, filled by the sky (10000K) and bounce off the bone leather, 6:1. Venus's nose is at 272°, 23° off the sun, which is also on her left, while the lens sits 55° to her right. Gold falls across the front of her face and her far cheek, and her near cheek turns into the edge of the light (short lighting), filled by the leather and her white shirt, 3:1. Her hair edge halates softly. PALLOR LOCK, measured after the film pass on matched patches of each sunlit cheek: his CIELAB chroma is no more than half of hers. His lips and lids hold the grey-ash hue at C* 8 or under. No skin secondary, warm window or grade move touches him, and any warmth on her is keyed to her alone. The gold lights his shape, never his colour; his skin is never lifted. Separation: his lit profile against the silver bonnet beyond, which the 9° sun only grazes (1-1.5 stops under); her dark hair and halated edge against sunlit caliche. SCREEN: a plain lit panel carrying the dash-arc frame of his collar, left jaw, ear and sunglasses arm in cool shade with a thin gold rim, in the phone look, with the REC dot, no timer and no trace of her: two of him, none of her. It is keystoned to 20°, 1 stop under her hair rim and below the halation threshold. It faces 356°, 107° off the sun, so no sun reaches the glass; it reflects only the shaded rear deck behind the seats, held under the picture.

contradictions_flagged: 1 · V01-SH15, V02-SH04, V01-SH20, SH20B, SH23 · Sound plan vs camera plan (owner: sound designer). Root cause: these cues were spotted to camera-plan timings that have since changed: the head turn is now 1.8 s, SH20 is split into SH20 and SH20B, and SH23 now has a head hold. SH15: the collar shift ends at f1114 (SH15 f34) and the quiet hold starts there, but the turn stops at f1123 (f43, 46.8 s). V02-SH04: SND-V02-003 maps SH04 f0 to V01 f1080, but the camera plan's source is V01 45.8-46.8 s (f1099-f1123), the last 1.0 s of the turn, so the SH03-SH04 elision is 2.0 s, not 1.2 s. By the cue's own rule, the creak stays on SH04 f0. SH20: the CP steps stop (f1483-f1495) runs 4 frames past the picture's stop (f1491) into the first tug. The T padlock targets fall at SH20 f63, after the tugs, and at SH20B f0, the silent dust insert; boarded on the picture's tugs at about f1496 and f1504. SH23: the CP sacks slide starts at f1863 (f135), 4 frames before the picture's slide at f139, during the head hold. Fix: collar shift f1080-f1123 and the quiet hold from f1123; V02 creak at f120, sourced from V01 f1099; steps stop f1482-f1491, knocks at f1496 and f1504, SH20B wind and sign only; sacks slide f1867-f1877. No picture change.

2 · V01-SH22 · SND-V01-011 vs the camera plan's SH22 restage (owner: sound designer). The off-screen bag drop (f1710-f1727, thud f1718 = SH22 f86) was spotted to the old drop at the jamb. The camera plan now keeps both bags on her in picture through f95 and puts the drop in the SH22-SH23 elision, at the world-bible marks inside the latch jamb. A thud at f86, while she visibly carries both bags, breaks the picture. Boarded as given and marked. Fix: cut the thud, since the drop is elided in both picture and sound.

3 · V01-SH25 · Camera plan SH25 (CP-9) vs script V01-B13 and SND-V01-013 (owner: cinematographer; sound designer to confirm). The camera plan turns the old 'steps cross the boards' into gravel steps outside, then a scrape and thud at 84.2-85.2 s, and places the lens 'once the door is shut'. The script's B13 sound is 'Only the wind outside, pushing at the door.' SND-V01-012 and 013 keep the door open on its stop (knocks at f38 and f101), and PR-15 has no shut state. SND-V01-012 now gives SH24 boots on the boards (f60-f89), which answers the old request. Boarded per the script and the sound plan. Fix: strike CP-9's sound note. If the director wants the gravel steps, the copywriter adds them to B13 first.

4 · S01-SH01 · The camera plan's declared viewpoint change vs the route and the stills copy (owner: cinematographer; Lucas decides under B6). The route and the script say 'from behind her right shoulder'. The camera plan moves the lens behind his right shoulder, outboard on his door side, so her face reads and his profile clears the pad. The route sits above the camera plan. Boarded as the camera plan frames it. Fix: Lucas approves the change along with the light choice (CP-8), or the cinematographer returns to her shoulder.

5 · V01-SH06, V02-SH02 · Route R2 ('handheld at arm's length inside the phone, jolting when she laughs') and script V01-B03 ('each cut landing on a different snatch of her laugh') vs camera plan SH06 ('no jolt in any frame', held still so V02-SH01 and SH02 register within a few pixels) (owner: sound designer). The laugh is on the phone mic, a hand's width from the lens: a fresh, loud onset over a dead-still frame is the only laugh in V01 or V02 that doesn't shake the picture, and it breaks the route's rule. Boarded as given and marked. Fix: at f367 (V02-SH02 f0-f12), cut in the decaying tail of a laugh that is already ending, not a fresh onset, so a settled frame is believable. This keeps the script's words ('a different snatch of her laugh') and the camera plan's registration. Dropping the snatch would break script B03 and needs the copywriter first. No picture change.

6 · V01-SH12, SH13 · Camera plan SH13 purpose ('The only laugh in V01 in sync') vs SND-V01-015 ('B06 plays as sync in both shots ... every peak sits within 2 frames of a visible torso shake in both shots') (owner: cinematographer; sound designer to confirm). At 4.5 m SH12 shows her whole laughing face and torso, so the laugh is in sync from SH12 f0 (f835), not only in SH13. The camera plan's sync method and fallbacks (picture-led cut, lip-sync pass, off-axis take) are written for SH13 only, which leaves SH12's mouth unprotected. Boarded per the sound plan: sync from SH12 f0, with SH12's mouth risk in its generation_risk and SH12 added to B1's lip-sync scope. Fix: the cinematographer amends SH13's purpose to 'sync across SH12-SH13' and extends its method and fallback to SH12.

7 · V01-SH07, SH17; V02-SH01, SH05 to SH07 · Camera plan V01-SH07 ('lands on the flip icon in the bottom bar') vs camera plan V02-SH01 and SH07 ('flip icon at 60-62% height, 70-74% across'; on his cheek in SH05) (owners: production design, who owns the UI; cinematographer). It is the same in-world phone and the route's hero gesture, and the icon moves between V01 and V02; cut side by side in the deck, it jumps. Boarded as each shot's plan places it. Fix: one UI layout used in both, with the icon clear of the 9:16 caption zone (below 80% height) and the right rail; the simplest is V02's mid-right position carried back into V01's phone picture, because V02's safe area is the harder constraint. Or log V02's UI as deliberately re-laid for the teaser, as the script logs the teaser clock. Either way, the glyph (about 43 px wide at 1080 in V02) must read as a camera-flip on its own at that size, or V02-SH07's muted read fails.

8 · V01-SH11 to SH12 · Camera plan SH12 action ('f0-f13: the grained pillars open over the tipping phone plate ... her right hand on her thigh beside the recording phone') vs SH11 ('From f14 the phone starts down toward her lap') and its composite note ('Over SH12 f0-f13 the plate tips toward her lap') (owner: cinematographer). The film plate under the composite has her right hand already at rest from f0 while the phone plate over it is still tipping, so the move exists in one layer and not the other. The cowl hides her lap and hand, so her right shoulder is the only place it can show. Boarded: SH12's entry equals SH11's exit, with the drop finishing under the cowl through f13 and her right hand on her thigh by f14. Fix: in the SH12 film plate her right shoulder dips with the drop through f13 and settles by f14, inside the laugh's torso shake. No change to framing or timing.

T hits (targets spotted to the generated picture) are boarded on the camera-plan action frame, with the plan's target noted where they differ: SH07-SH08 laugh, SH14 scratch, SH16 tick, SH17 laugh, SH19 latch and knock, SH20 padlock, SH21 boot lid, SH22 shoves and door stop, SH23 sacks in the dark. Only CP hits that disagree with the picture are flagged.

REC cards carry the script beat's value from the beat's first frame, run in real time and are composited in finishing. SH03, SH08 and SH10 carry their beat's running value. SH16 has no card, because the timer returns at SH17 f0.

FILM RULE (Lucas's 35mm direction, the same in V01, V02 and the stills): every film frame keeps the camera plan's Super 35 lens perspective and depth. Plates are generated clean, and one shared film layer goes on in finishing: fine grain sized to frame height, halation only above one highlight threshold (practicals, rims, the lantern globe, the candle), gentle highlight roll-off, and a black floor at #0A0A0A. Reject any plate with baked-in grain, bloom or blacks below #0A0A0A. V02 and each still get their own film pass at output size, so the grain never enlarges with a crop. Upstream clash: the route's 'outside the phone, clean' gives way to 35mm film, as the script's decision already records.

PHONE RULE: what we see on her phone stays phone video (deep focus, clipped sky, compression, phone white balance, no halation, bloom or shallow depth), with only the film grain on top, because the whole picture is a film print that contains a phone screen. The reason is R2: the phone is how she sees him, and film arrives only when she lowers it (SH12). It applies to V01-SH01 to SH11 and SH17, V02-SH01, SH02 and SH05 to SH07, and the S01 screen.

Elisions (the camera plan's, marked in the entry states): SH21 to SH22 (her walk to the track); SH22 to SH23 (her walk to the table and the bag drop at the jamb); SH23 to SH24 (her walk to wall D and all but the chair's last 0.8 m); SH24 to SH25 (declared: she is outside at f0); V02-SH03 to SH04 (2.0 s); V02-SH06 to SH07 (2.6 s).

Hand marks come from the cast bible's VENUS lock ('locked by the director's ruling'): right hand, a 2 cm scar across the back between the thumb and index knuckles and a 6 mm nick across the back of the thumb at its first joint; left hand, a 1 cm glossy oval burn on the back of the index finger just above the knuckle. Where the camera plan names no hand: SH20, SH23 and SH24 are both hands. S03's reaching hand is boarded as her left, because stool 3 sits north of the house (frame-right) and the house lies to her front-left, which makes the left index the drawing finger; if the hand double works the right, the scar and nick face the lens instead, and the cinematographer confirms on the tabletop day. The SH19 body double's right hand must carry the same marks as the hand double's.
The screen-direction ruling is CP-7 in every panel, carried as this board's B8 for V01-SH07, SH17 and V02-SH07. SH16 keeps the phone out of frame, so CP-7 doesn't bind it.
The route has no product, so PR-01, her phone, is tracked as the product stand-in and there is no product shot.

Taste notes. 'Hands before faces' is followed (her face first appears at SH12, his at SH15), and in this piece her hands carry her identity, which is why every hand panel names its mark; it is broken on purpose in S01, as decided upstream. 'Sound design before music' is followed, with no score in V01 or V02. 'Restraint over explanation' drives the reads in SH14, SH19, SH20B, SH22 and SH23. blockers.issue: B1 · The Venus actor's written consent for her laugh (SND-V01-015, SND-V02-005). (b) The SH06/V02-SH02 laugh snatch is now flag 5, and the old 'Not flagged' line is gone: the laugh is on the phone mic, so a fresh onset over a still frame breaks the route's rule. (c) SH12 is boarded as sync (flag 6), with its mouth risk in generation_risk and SH12 added to B1's lip-sync scope; 'V01's only sync laugh' is struck from SH13. (d) Every panel where her hand shows names the hand and the locked mark that faces the lens. B2's line reopening the burn is struck, because the cast bible records the marks as locked by the director's ruling. SH19's read is corrected: her left hand did the collar, her right hand takes the pistol. (e) The flip icon's position is flag 7, and V02-SH07 now states what has to read muted. (f) The camera plan's blockers are named CP-3, CP-7, CP-8 and CP-9 everywhere; the screen ruling is this board's B8; SH07's entry says 'screen direction per CP-7' and no longer settles it. (g) V02-SH06 no longer claims the shake reads as a laugh when muted.

Bag marks: the world bible puts PR-05 inside the latch jamb (x 195-245, y 10-38) with PR-06 slumped half on it (x 195-240, y 22-50), below and left of the SH25/S02 frame, and the camera plan's SH23 says 'the bags lie at their marks by the latch jamb'. The commissioner's earlier note asked for the window (x 40-140). The production designer's jamb mark supersedes it, and both keep the bags out of the held frame, which is what the note wanted. They are recorded as 'at the jamb, below frame', never 'in front of or under the lens'. PR-23 is recorded at its marks: two ranks in the north-east corner, low right of the held frame.
Jean's head positions follow the camera plan: P1 is his head turned to the door with his cheek on the pad; P2 is his face turned toward the driver's seat, where she set it (from the stop in SH15).

S01 collar: CP-8 option C (REC about 00:12, read as 12 min, with the sun at 9°) falls between SH02 (00:06:12) and SH04 (00:21:40), so the collar is C2 and the dash is D2. If Lucas's choice (B6) moves it before 00:06:12, the collar becomes C1.

T hits (targets spotted to the generated picture) are boarded on the camera-plan action frame, with the plan's target noted where they differ: SH07-SH08 laugh, SH14 scratch, SH16 tick, SH17 laugh, SH19 latch and knock, SH20 padlock, SH21 boot lid, SH22 shoves and door stop, SH23 sacks in the dark. Only CP hits that disagree with the picture are flagged.

REC cards carry the script beat's value from the beat's first frame, run in real time and are composited in finishing. SH03, SH08 and SH10 carry their beat's running value. SH16 has no card, because the timer returns at SH17 f0.

FILM RULE (Lucas's 35mm direction, the same in V01, V02 and the stills): every film frame keeps the camera plan's Super 35 lens perspective and depth. Plates are generated clean, and one shared film layer goes on in finishing: fine grain sized to frame height, halation only above one highlight threshold (practicals, rims, the lantern globe, the candle), gentle highlight roll-off, and a black floor at #0A0A0A. Reject any plate with baked-in grain, bloom or blacks below #0A0A0A. V02 and each still get their own film pass at output size, so the grain never enlarges with a crop. Upstream clash: the route's 'outside the phone, clean' gives way to 35mm film, as the script's decision already records.

PHONE RULE: what we see on her phone stays phone video (deep focus, clipped sky, compression, phone white balance, no halation, bloom or shallow depth), with only the film grain on top, because the whole picture is a film print that contains a phone screen. The reason is R2: the phone is how she sees him, and film arrives only when she lowers it (SH12). It applies to V01-SH01 to SH11 and SH17, V02-SH01, SH02 and SH05 to SH07, and the S01 screen.

Elisions (the camera plan's, marked in the entry states): SH21 to SH22 (her walk to the track); SH22 to SH23 (her walk to the table and the bag drop at the jamb); SH23 to SH24 (her walk to wall D and all but the chair's last 0.8 m); SH24 to SH25 (declared: she is outside at f0); V02-SH03 to SH04 (2.0 s); V02-SH06 to SH07 (2.6 s).

Hand marks come from the cast bible's VENUS lock ('locked by the director's ruling'): right hand, a 2 cm scar across the back between the thumb and index knuckles and a 6 mm nick across the back of the thumb at its first joint; left hand, a 1 cm glossy oval burn on the back of the index finger just above the knuckle. Where the camera plan names no hand: SH20, SH23 and SH24 are both hands. S03's reaching hand is boarded as her left, because stool 3 sits north of the house (frame-right) and the house lies to her front-left, which makes the left index the drawing finger; if the hand double works the right, the scar and nick face the lens instead, and the cinematographer confirms on the tabletop day. The SH19 body double's right hand must carry the same marks as the hand double's.
The screen-direction ruling is CP-7 in every panel, carried as this board's B8 for V01-SH07, SH17 and V02-SH07. SH16 keeps the phone out of frame, so CP-7 doesn't bind it.
The route has no product, so PR-01, her phone, is tracked as the product stand-in and there is no product shot.

Taste notes. 'Hands before faces' is followed (her face first appears at SH12, his at SH15), and in this piece her hands carry her identity, which is why every hand panel names its mark; it is broken on purpose in S01, as decided upstream. 'Sound design before music' is followed, with no score in V01 or V02. 'Restraint over explanation' drives the reads in SH14, SH19, SH20B, SH22 and SH23. The status is review_required, not blocked: none of the pending items stops boarding.

SH23: "her head drops into frame as a dark shape inside one of his photographs and holds, looking at the bare boards beside her chair where his will go". S01: "Two of him, none of her." evidence.fit: Lucas's 35mm direction is answered as a rule, with a reason and a plan for every deliverable: "PHONE RULE: what we see on her phone stays phone video ... because the whole picture is a film print that contains a phone screen. The reason is R2: the phone is how she sees him, and film arrives only when she lowers it (SH12)", and "V02 and each still get their own film pass at output size, so the grain never enlarges with a crop." Clashes with the route go to their owners and are not settled quietly (flag 4 goes to Lucas under B6; flag 5 is decided in the route's favour over the camera plan). The muted read of V02 is described honestly: "If the glyph doesn't read at feed size, the beat reads as a thumb on a screen and nothing more (flag 7)." Both verified facts are on screen: the gun (SH19-SH24) and the wall with none of them together (SH23-SH26, S02). No must-avoid is broken.
evidence.craft: Every note from the last round has been fixed properly. The SH11 to SH12 handover is now written out and flagged: "PR-01 in her right hand below the cowl, finishing its drop face up into her lap through f13 while the tipping phone plate is composited over the film plate; right hand settles on her thigh by f14 (flag 8)." The laugh snatch is now a flag with the right reasoning: "The laugh is on the phone mic, a hand's width from the lens: a fresh, loud onset over a dead-still frame is the only laugh in V01 or V02 that doesn't shake the picture." SH12 is now boarded as sync, B8 separates the screen-direction ruling, and SH19 is corrected: "takes a pistol from the glovebox with her right hand". It doesn't reach 9 for two reasons. The checks claim hand marks were checked "on all 15 panels where her hand shows", but SH12, SH21 and SH22 show her hands and aren't covered. Pixel-registered image editing (the SH04-SH05 collar state on the locked Jean pass)

assumptions: 35mm look across every deliverable: each film-shot still prompt ends on one fixed film-look sentence (moving or static), and film clips must show natural 24 fps blur. Kit sheets stay neutral. Generation stays grain-free. Grain, halation and highlight roll-off are one film layer added in finishing to each master at its own output size (V01 16:9, V02 at a 1080 px short side, S01 2:3, S02 16:9, S03 4:5), so the grain reads the same size everywhere and 720p grain is never enlarged. V02-SH03/SH04 are regenerated on the rolled S35 gate, and S01 and S03 are extracted from the S35 gate as boarded.

Phone footage stays in-world phone video on purpose: it is her gaze on him, never on herself, and the frame opening to film at SH12 is the reveal. The phone picture keeps deep focus, clipped highlights, short-shutter crispness and dusk noise. One 35mm grain layer runs over the whole frame, phone picture and V01 pillars included (in V02, the 3% surround), so each piece reads as one film print holding a phone picture. Nothing else from film (no halation, roll-off or 1/48 s blur) enters the phone picture.

Handles: every image-to-video clip's frame 0 is shot f-12, except SH07 clip 1 (a declared 4-frame head, frame 0 = shot f-4, because SH07 opens on a hard time-jump cut and 120 frames must reach the f115 join). Clips that open at rest hold half a second (SH03, SH11-TIP, SH16, SH18, SH21); clips already moving at f0 put every in-clip time 0.5 s after the board's (SH02 curls, SH12 and SH13 laughs, SH20 and SH22 walks). Checks name both clip time and shot frame.

SH09-SH11 are rebuilt on the SH01-SH08 pattern: background-only plates (SH09-IMG-BG, then SH09-VID-BG, SH10-VID-BG1 and BG2), with STL-JEAN-P1-SHADE@v1 (dusted, standing in for C3) and CURL2 composited over them. SH09's blue cast, chroma noise, compression blocks and drift smear are the phone finishing pass on the comp, so the collar is never relit. SH10's LED is a timed relight grade through a collar-and-pad matte, as SH16's pool, and its glinting C3 dust is a generated collar-band element (SH10-DUST). The only generated clip on picture is the SH11 f14 to SH12 f13 tip-down, where the board says the smear forgives the generator.

Chained joins with no end-frame input: SH07 f115 (clip 1 f-4 to f115, 120 f; clip 2 from f115, covering SH07 f115-f117, SH08 and a 12-frame tail, 89 f); SH09 to SH10 under the exposure pop (BG1 from SH09-BG's f60 frame); SH10 f58 under the road-bump jolt (BG2 from BG1's f46 frame); SH11 f14 (tip clip from the approved comp frame); SH12 f107; SH15 f43 (reversed) and road f107; SH17 plate A to C at f119; SH22 f19 to the practical at f20.

Clash with the review notes on SH15 and V02-SH04: the storyboard makes the turn 120 degrees in 43 frames (P1 to P2, through dead ahead), fingers from a practical rig 3b plate. I adopted the head-alone sentence and the difference-matte checks. V02-SH04 runs the same full turn on its own 9:16 still and keeps the last 24 frames (about 65 degrees by the tracked curve, not the note's 43), with its own rig 3b pass. The casting bible still says about 60 degrees (blocker 3).

'Keyed rotation of the registered head element' is read as a generated head-only turn keyed over the torso held from the still, its tracked curve driving the rotator; a true CG head is outside generation. Played reversed, generated hair would run backwards, so the turns hold hair still and a forward crown-curl layer is tracked on; if it slips, still curls for 1.8 s (flagged to the director).

Collar continuity: the Jean pass is C1 for SH01 and the head above the band in SH02-SH03; its C2 state pass carries SH04-SH05; from SH06 the dusted pass returns as the points film over, through SH09; SH10-SH11 add the C3 LED band. S01's screen uses the C2 pass.

Laugh triage: lip-sync is scored central. SH12 (two people 1 + lip-sync 2 + motion 1) and SH13 (lip-sync 2 + motion 1 + two people 1) both reach 4, so the board's alternatives go to the director before any clip runs: the lip-sync pass with the consented take (consent 2), and for SH13 the off-axis take with her head tipped back.

Venus references: CHR-VENUS-FACE@v1 goes to every job where her face reads (SH12, SH13, SH14, SH16, S01); CHR-VENUS-BODY@v1 to the back views (SH19, SH20, SH20B, SH22). SH13's soft Jean is composited from SH12-IMG-J and its light matched by check. Two-person frames are separate person plates on grey registered to one car base per shot (SH12, SH16, S01); SH12's car holds still in frame.

Every prompt states the wanted state, because the profile has no negative prompt; negatives appear only in checks, apart from 'never forming words' in the laugh prompts. Image-to-video prompts run 45-60 words, motion only; hero stills run 80-120 words and now state what is sharp and soft.

ASPECT: the profile's 1024 px image is read as square, so every non-square frame is a crop and marked unsupported. V01-SH17 plates A and C fit the profile for V01 at 720p but miss the board's 4K-equivalent for V02; V02-SH05, SH06 and SH07 are marked unsupported (blocker 5).

Wall: 12 prints in the style bible's three rails (K08-A night shirt: 01-04, 11; K08-B day tee: 05-07, 10; K08-C October overshirt: 08, 09, 12 at dusk). Three crops each, never flipped, for 36 variants over about 250 cells, weighted 40/40/20 and half night, half day, no identical variant within two cells. PRINT-JEAN-02 sits at C13-R1 with his head in the upper half.

Ledger, worst case at 2 variations x 3 rounds: 414 images and 222 clips, price unknown. Images: 120 kit (8 sheets = 48, 12 prints = 72), 222 shot stills from 37 jobs, 72 previs from 12 jobs. Clips: 37 x 6 = 222, six more than the last version because SH09-SH11 now take four background and tip clips in place of three whole-frame clips. direction.note: Shoot it in a 35mm film style. lenses.verdict: Not for production today. This is the most distinctive package this idea could get. The phone-versus-film rule answers Lucas's 35mm direction with a reason, and every department serves the route: her shadow on him, her head inside one of his prints, the front camera used once per man. It is not yet a single document a crew can shoot from. Three contradictions will stop the floor on day one, and one of them nobody has flagged: the sound plan's D01 music grid runs about 10 s off the treatment and at a different tempo. The other two are where Jean's sunglasses are at the bar and whether the motel door is open or shut. The director still hasn't ruled on which way the phone screen faces, which blocks three hero plates. V02's hero punch-in fails its own check at 720p. V02 also ends on a title over black, an unflagged break of the taste notes. Every consent, price and capability is still open. Make the 20 notes and get Lucas's answers on the proposition, A02, S01 and heritage. At that point this is an A, and I would put it in front of a commissioner.

evidence.specificity: Most of the package can be built without a follow-up call, down to the frame. SND-V02-001 is an example: "At f29 (V01 f161) the collar creases dry under the pinch: this is the hook's sync sound, inside 1.5 s." It stops at 8 because a crew would still have to ask three things. Is the motel door open or shut? SND-V01-013 has "the door knocks against its stop at f2006 and f2069", while camera plan SH25 has "a declared virtual position once the door is shut". Are Jean's sunglasses on him at the bar? The treatment's SC04 blocking has "PR-04 hooked in his placket", while the style bible has "Placket bare SC04-SC15: nothing hooked, clipped or tacked to it." And which music grid do the performers play to (see craft)?
evidence.distinctiveness: Swap in any other vigilante show and the work breaks. Camera plan SH01: "Her shadow on him is the only trace of her in her own footage (R2)." SH23 has her head rising into one of his prints "so she is inside a photograph of him as a shape, not a face." The route: "She comes to a full stop at a stop sign nobody else will ever reach." Add the chimney straw, which ends up in the trash on the pink cloth, and the front camera used once per man, afterwards. Every department serves the same idea.
evidence.fit: Lucas's cold open, his decorum dialogue, the white apartment and his engine are all here, and they are sharper than he wrote them. All nine must-includes land. His 35mm direction is answered on purpose: "Her footage stays phone video, because it is her way of seeing him... Halation, roll-off, S35 depth and 1/48 s blur arrive only at SH12, so the split reads with the sound off." It stops at 8 for two reasons. V02 ends on "the upright frame goes black, the red REC dot is gone, and the LIMERENCE title card sits centred in the dark", which is a taste-note break nobody flagged. And the exec-facing D01 opens with "Proposition (pending Lucas's approval)".
evidence.craft: The work is expert, but departments contradict each other in ways a professional would catch on a first read. (1) The sound plan says "Composer brief: 120 BPM in 4/4 (beat 0.5 s, bar 2.0 s), one four-bar loop of 8.0 s". The treatment says "The editor phases the 9.6 s loop so its downbeats fall at 150.0 minus multiples of 9.6". The rasp, the line and the switch-off are about 10 s apart between the two documents, and no one has flagged it. (2) The style bible puts the sunglasses in the duffel under a "film director's ruling", but the director's treatment has him "unhooks PR-04 from the placket (0.8)". (3) The casting bible still turns the head "about 60°", while the treatment, the world bible and the camera plan turn it 120°. (4) The generation plan lists "Video output above 720p, or a video upscaler" as missing, for a pitch hero, and V02's hero punch-in is marked unsupported.

lenses.verdict: A distinctive, deeply specified package that stays true to Lucas's idea and handles his 35mm direction with a clear rationale. I can't shoot it next week from these pages without a follow-up call. The departments disagree about the sunglasses, the door, the music loop, the icon size and the head-turn arc. Rulings are still open on the blind phone screen and the laugh method. The make-or-break SH15 has no fallback that avoids the generated head turn. Approve once the notes above land and Lucas answers the direction questions.

evidence.specificity: Every department writes to a measurable, shootable target. For example, the style bible's wear on Venus's jeans: "the right back pocket is faded to #A9B9C9 in an L, the outline of the part of PR-02 that rides inside it". The camera plan's thumb beat is timed as "the thumb slides onto the icon (1.0), rests there without pressing (2.2), then slides back". Positions, frame counts and hex values are pinned down across all 38 boards. Nothing is left generic.
evidence.distinctiveness: The route gives the show something it alone owns. Only this series could run "Every episode opens on her phone recording the next man, and the front camera turns on only once per man, at the table, afterwards." The details carry the same idea: the chimney straw, the dash cam she keeps her face out of, and her hand passing the phone to turn the speaker up. Every one of them serves 'she is never in his frame'.
evidence.fit: The package holds to Lucas's idea and to his 35mm direction. It keeps "every must-include beat of Lucas's cold open in his order". On 35mm it makes a reasoned call: "Her footage stays phone video, because it is her way of seeing him," with one grain layer over the whole print so every deliverable matches. Two deviations are declared but still need Lucas: the key art moves from behind her shoulder (as the route and stills copy ask) to behind his, and the key message is rewritten.
evidence.craft: Each document is well built, but the documents disagree with each other on things the shoot depends on. The generation plan logs one of them itself: "the storyboard's turn is 120 degrees (P1 to P2); the casting bible says about 60." Others: the treatment puts the sunglasses in the placket while the style bible puts them in the duffel. The treatment times the music to a 9.6 s loop while the sound plan specs 8.0 s. The door is open in one plan and shut in another. The icon is drawn at 4% of V02's width against a 6% spec. The phone's screen faces away from Venus, and nobody has ruled on it. The make-or-break SH15 depends on an untested stack of techniques with no fallback that avoids the generated head turn.

lenses.verdict: There is a show here: V01 plays a love story until his eyes land, the front-camera device belongs to this idea alone, and D01 carries a season engine that repeats. I would not approve it for production today. The departments disagree on the motel door, the sunglasses, the angle of Jean's head turn and the D01 music grid (about 10 s apart), and V02's eye shots can't be delivered at the generation plan's 720p. Fix those and settle Lucas's calls on the proposition, the S01 framing and the casting, and this reaches a 9.

evidence.specificity: Nearly every beat is pinned to a concrete, filmable detail instead of a mood. Script SC01: "At a stop sign nobody else will ever reach, she brushes the dust off his black shirt and straightens his collar." Camera plan SH20B: "The step's dust fills about half the frame height, so 'untouched' reads with the sound off." The props are tracked just as closely, e.g. PR-50: "a pharmacy fill slip ... whose only legible text is the date, verbatim '09/18/2026'." I can't see where more specificity would help.
evidence.distinctiveness: The route device belongs to this idea alone: "She isn't collecting trophies; she's trying to get into one photograph with him." It pays off in SC18: "Her thumb goes to the flip-camera icon, and this time it presses." It also turns into the engine: "the front camera turns on only once per man, at the table, afterwards." Two things hold it at 8. The competitor check has not been run (H3: "You and Killing Eve both lead with a killer's obsessive, unreturned love. In Promising Young Woman the heroine falls for a man who turns out to be implicated"). And the permission problem is still open: "there are no credits, attached producer or prior work that an exec could check."
evidence.fit: Lucas's cold open, his order of events and his bar dialogue survive almost word for word, from 'Have we met before?' through the Naked and Famous to 'Who slayed you, my friend?'. His 35mm direction is answered with a deliberate choice about the phone footage: "Her footage stays phone video, because it is her way of seeing him ... Halation, roll-off, S35 depth and 1/48 s blur arrive only at SH12, so the split reads with the sound off." What holds it at 8 is the FRONT page an exec reads first. "What she wants from every one of them is for him to love her back, and none of them does" rules out the brief's season question (A17). The strategy already flagged the same flaw in the key message.
evidence.craft: Taken one department at a time, V01 is meticulous: a declared 260° sun cheat so her shadow can land on him, and a first frame of film at the exact moment she lowers the phone. The departments do not agree with each other, though. The sound plan places the SC15 rasp "at 1379.8 s", but the treatment has it at 99.6 s into the scene, which is pilot 1389.6. The treatment wants the switch-off "on the 67.2 downbeat, so the next bar never lands"; the sound plan wants it to "stop the track hard mid-bar". The motel door is "dragged shut" in the treatment but stays "open at 90° from here to the end" in the sound plan and storyboard. The sunglasses ride in the placket in the treatment and world bible but in "PR-05's outside pocket" in the style bible. Casting says the head turn is "about 60°"; the treatment and world bible say 120°. On top of that, the V02 eye punch-ins "fail at 720p".
